howTo.title: Ukudlala i-Sudoku: imithetho, ibhodi nezinyathelo zokuqala
howTo.description: Funda ukudlala i-Sudoku: imithetho, indlela imigqa, amakholomu namabhokisi asebenza ngayo, isixazululo esisodwa, amanothi nezinyathelo zakho zokuqala.
howTo.summary: I-Sudoku iyimfumbe yokucabanga egridini engu-9×9. Gcwalisa iseli ngalinye elingenalutho ngenombolo esuka ku-1 kuya ku-9 ukuze umugqa ngamunye, ikholomu ngalinye nebhokisi ngalinye elingu-3×3 kube nenombolo ngayinye kanye kuphela. Ezinye izinombolo zinikezwa ekuqaleni; ezinye uzithola ngokucabanga, iseli elilodwa eliqinisekile ngesikhathi, futhi awudingi ukuqagela nanini. Lo mhlahlandlela uchaza ibhodi, imithetho, umgomo wesixazululo esisodwa, amanothi necebo elilula lezinyathelo zakho zokuqala. Konke lokhu ungakuzama ku-[Bare Sudoku](play), eyamahhala futhi enezexwayiso ezichaza ukucabanga.

p: Kunemithetho emithathu kuphela, futhi empeleni ingumthetho owodwa obukwa ngezinhlangothi ezintathu: umugqa ngamunye kufanele ube nezinombolo 1 kuya ku-9, ikholomu ngalinye kufanele libe nezinombolo 1 kuya ku-9, nebhokisi ngalinye elingu-3×3 kufanele libe nezinombolo 1 kuya ku-9. Ngakho inombolo ayisoze yavela kabili emugqeni owodwa, ekholomu elilodwa noma ebhokisini elilodwa.

Izinombolo ezinikeziwe, eziphrintwe ngokugqamile, azishintshi. Umsebenzi wakho ukugcwalisa amaseli angenalutho. Akukho zibalo futhi akukho kulandelana: izinombolo zimane nje ziyizimpawu eziyisishiyagalolunye ezahlukene. Ungadlala ngezinhlamvu noma ngezimo, futhi akukho okwakungashintsha.

Ibhodi linamaseli angu-81 emigqeni engu-9 namakholomu angu-9. Imidwebo ewugqinsi ilihlukanisa libe amabhokisi ayisishiyagalolunye angu-3×3. Iseli ngalinye lisemugqeni owodwa, ekholomu elilodwa nasebhokisini elilodwa ncamashi, futhi lawa maqembu amathathu angamayunithi alo. Amanye amaseli angu-20 ahlanganyela iyunithi neseli abizwa ngokuthi omakhelwane balo; inombolo efakwe eselini ivimbela leyo nombolo kubo bonke omakhelwane abangu-20.

Amaseli abhalwa njenge-r3c7: umugqa 3, ikholomu 7. Imigqa ibalwa kusukela phezulu, amakholomu kusukela kwesobunxele, bese amabhokisi 1 kuya ku-9 kusukela phezulu kwesobunxele, umugqa ngomugqa. Lolu hlelo lokubhala lusetshenziswa kuwo wonke umhlahlandlela wezindlela futhi kufanelekile ukulufunda: i-r5c5 iphakathi nendawo yebhodi.

sections.h: Kungani yonke i-Sudoku inesixazululo esisodwa ncamashi?
p: I-Sudoku efanele inesixazululo esisodwa, futhi yilokho okwenza ukucabanga kusebenze. Noma nini lapho ungakhombisa ukuthi inombolo ayikwazi ukungena kwenye indawo eyunithini, kufanele ingene eselini elisele, ngoba isixazululo sikhona futhi siyingqayizivele. Uma imfumbe ibinezixazululo ezimbili, akukho kucabanga okwakungazihlukanisa, futhi ngesinye isikhathi bekuzofanele uqagele.

I-Bare Sudoku idala yonke imfumbe kudivayisi yakho futhi ihlole ukuthi inesixazululo esisodwa ncamashi nokuthi isixazululi sayo esisebenzisa ukucabanga singayiqeda ngezindlela zezinga olikhethile. Ngakho uma ubambekile, kuhlale kunesinyathelo esilandelayo okufanele usithole, futhi isexwayiso siyasikhombisa.
Qala ngalokho okuvinjelwe kakhulu. Lolu hlelo lusebenza kuwo wonke amazinga:
list: Khetha inombolo esevele kaningi, isibonelo izikhathi eziyisithupha noma eziyisikhombisa, bese uthola amabhokisi angakabi nayo. Kaningi kusala iseli elilodwa kuphela ebhokisini: lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi [oyedwa ofihlekile](hidden-single).

Funa amaseli aminyene. Iseli elinezinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili ezahlukene sezizonke emugqeni walo, ekholomu lalo nasebhokisini lalo lisele nomlingani oyedwa kuphela: lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi [oyedwa osobala](naked-single). Indawo engcono kakhulu yokubheka ngamaseli asemigqeni noma emabhokisini acishe agcwele.
Yonke inombolo oyifakayo isusa umlingani komakhelwane abangu-20, ngakho hlola labo makhelwane ngokushesha. Ababodwa bavame ukuza ngochungechunge.

Uma ukufaka okulula sekuphelile, bhala amanothi: abalingani beseli ngalinye elingenalutho. Bese ufuna inombolo evalelwe emugqeni owodwa noma ekholomu elilodwa ngaphakathi kwebhokisi ([abalingani abakhiyiwe](locked-candidates)) noma amaseli amabili anabalingani ababili abafanayo ([ababili abasobala](naked-pairs)).
Buyela kwababodwa ngemva kokususa ngakunye. Ngisho nezimfumbe zochwepheshe zixazululwa kakhulu ngababodwa; indlela ethuthukile ivula nje olandelayo.

sections.h: Ayini amanothi futhi kufanele uwasebenzise nini?
p: Amanothi, abizwa nangokuthi amamaki epensela noma abalingani, yizinombolo ezincane ozibhala eselini elingenalutho ukuze uqophe ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ezisenokwenzeka lapho. Ezimfumbeni ezilula awuvamile ukuwadinga; kusukela ezingeni elithi Kunzima kuya phezulu abalulekile, ngoba izindlela ezifana nababili, i-X-Wing ne-Y-Wing zimayelana nabalingani, hhayi nezinombolo ezifakiwe.

Gcina amanothi enembile: uma ufaka inombolo, yisuse emanothini abo bonke omakhelwane abangu-20. Ku-Bare Sudoku lokhu kwenzeka ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi inkinobho ethi Gcwalisa amanothi ibhala wonke umlingani kuwo wonke amaseli angenalutho ngokuthinta okukodwa, ukuze uqale ngeqoqo eliphelele nelilungile labalingani. Inothi liyiqiniso, hhayi ukuqagela: lisho ukuthi akukho okuvimbela le nombolo okwamanje.

Okokuqala phinda uhlole izisekelo: umugqa ngamunye, ikholomu ngalinye nebhokisi ngalinye elicishe ligcwale kungumthombo wababodwa. Bese uqinisekisa ukuthi amanothi aphelele, ngoba umlingani ongekho ufihla amaphethini, kanti umlingani ongasasebenzi udala amaphethini angamanga. Bese uzama [izindlela](techniques) ngokulandelana kobunzima: abalingani abakhiyiwe, ababili nabathathu, i-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing, i-Swordfish ne-XYZ-Wing. Ngayinye inekhasi layo elinesibonelo sangempela.

Uma kungekho okusebenzayo, thatha isexwayiso. Ku-Bare Sudoku isexwayiso siqala ngokuhlola ukuthi ikhona yini inombolo efakiwe engalungile, bese sithola iseli elilandelayo elingagcwaliswa ngokucabanga futhi sisho igama lendlela, ukuze ufunde okuthile ngisho noma usisebenzisa. Thinta isexwayiso futhi ukuze ufake inombolo.

Thinta iseli, bese uthinta inombolo. Noma thinta inombolo kuqala: iyakhiywa, futhi wonke amaseli owathintayo ayayithola, okuyindlela eshesha kakhulu yokufaka ikhophi yesithupha, yesikhombisa neyesishiyagalombili yenombolo. Thinta inombolo futhi ukuze uyikhulule. Inkinobho ethi Amanothi ishintshela kumamaki epensela, ethi Sula isula iseli, ethi Buyisela ihlehlisa noma yisiphi isinyathelo, futhi amaphutha amakwa ngokubomvu ngaphandle uma ukuvala lokho kumenyu.

Kwikhibhodi, sebenzisa izinkinobho zemicibisholo ukuze uhambe, 1 kuya ku-9 ukufaka inombolo, Backspace ukusula, N yamanothi, U ukubuyisela, H yesexwayiso, F ukugcwalisa amanothi kanye ne-Escape yemenyu. Umdlalo uzilondoloza wona, usebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, awunazo izikhangiso futhi awudingi i-akhawunti.

faq: Ingabe kuyadingeka ukuqagela ku-Sudoku?

Cha, uma imfumbe ifanele. Yonke imfumbe ye-Bare Sudoku inesixazululo esisodwa ncamashi futhi ihlolwe ukuthi ingaxazululwa ngokucabanga kuphela, kuze kufike ezindleleni zezinga layo. Uma uzwa sengathi kufanele uqagele, kukhona umlingani ongekho emanothini akho noma kukhona indlela esalindile ukutholwa.
Ingabe inombolo ingavela kabili emugqeni, ekholomu noma ebhokisini?

Cha. Lowo ungumthetho wonke: kuyo yonke imigqa eyisishiyagalolunye, amakholomu ayisishiyagalolunye namabhokisi ayisishiyagalolunye, inombolo ngayinye kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-9 ivela kanye kuphela. Uma izinombolo ezimbili ezifanayo zikuyunithi eyodwa, okungenani eyodwa yazo ayilungile.
Uyini umehluko phakathi kwamazinga athi Kulula, Maphakathi, Kunzima no-Uchwepheshe?

Izinga linqunywa yizindlela imfumbe ezidingayo. Izimfumbe ezithi Kulula nezithi Maphakathi zixazululwa ngababodwa kuphela, futhi ezithi Kulula ziqala nezinombolo ezinikeziwe okungenani ezingu-38. Ezithi Kunzima zidinga abalingani abakhiyiwe noma ababili nabathathu. Ezithi Uchwepheshe zidinga i-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing, i-Swordfish noma i-XYZ-Wing.
Kungcono ukugcwalisa amanothi kuwo wonke amaseli noma kwamanye kuphela?

Ezimfumbeni ezinzima nezochwepheshe, wagcwalise wonke: amaphethini afana nababili, i-X-Wing ne-Y-Wing avela kuphela lapho wonke umlingani ebhaliwe. Ezimfumbeni ezilula nezimaphakathi, amanothi awaphoqelekile futhi abadlali abaningi bamane bafune ababodwa.
I-Sudoku ithatha isikhathi esingakanani?

Imfumbe elula ithatha imizuzu embalwa; izimfumbe zochwepheshe zingathatha imizuzu engamashumi amabili noma ngaphezulu, kuye ngokuthi uyibona ngokushesha kangakanani iphethini ethuthukile. I-Bare Sudoku ibonisa isibalisikhathi, isimisa lapho imenyu ivuliwe futhi ayigcini uhlu lwabaphambili, ngakho dlala ngejubane lakho.
Ingabe i-Sudoku idinga izibalo?

Cha. Izinombolo zimane ziyizimpawu nje; akukho ukuhlanganisa noma ukubala. Noma yiziphi izimpawu eziyisishiyagalolunye bezingasebenza, yingakho i-Sudoku iyimfumbe yokucabanga kunokuba ibe yimfumbe yezinombolo.

index.title: Izindlela zokuxazulula i-Sudoku zichazwe ngezibonelo
index.description: Zonke izindlela eziyisishiyagalolunye zokuxazulula i-Sudoku, kusukela koyedwa osobala kuya ku-Swordfish ne-XYZ-Wing, ngokulandelana kwezexwayiso ze-Bare Sudoku.
intro: Yonke i-Sudoku ingaxazululwa ngeqoqo elincane lezindlela zokucabanga. Lolu hlu lubala izindlela eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisetshenziswa yisixazululi se-Bare Sudoku nezexwayiso zaso, ngokulandelana isixazululi esizizama ngakho: ababodwa kuqala, bese ukususa ngaphakathi kweyunithi eyodwa, bese amaphethini adlula emigqeni nasemakholomu amaningana. Indlela ngayinye inekhasi layo elinencazelo, indlela yokuyibona, isibonelo sangempela esivela emfumbeni edaliwe namaphutha ajwayelekile.

Izinga lemfumbe linqunywa yindlela enzima kakhulu eyidingayo. Izimfumbe ezilula nezimaphakathi zidinga ababodwa kuphela, izimfumbe ezinzima zidinga abalingani abakhiyiwe noma ababili nabathathu, kanti izimfumbe zochwepheshe zidinga okungenani inhlanzi eyodwa noma iphiko elilodwa. Noma ngabe yiliphi izinga, ababodwa benza umsebenzi omningi; indlela ethuthukile isusa umlingani oyedwa noma ababili, bese ababodwa beqhubeka ukusuka lapho.
faq: Kufanele ngizizame ngaluphi uhlelo izindlela ze-Sudoku?

Ezishibhile kuqala: oyedwa osobala, oyedwa ofihlekile, abalingani abakhiyiwe, ababili nabathathu abasobala, ababili nabathathu abafihlekile, i-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing, i-Swordfish, i-XYZ-Wing. I-Bare Sudoku izizama ngalolu hlelo ncamashi, futhi isexwayiso sihlale sisho igama lendlela elula kakhulu eqhubekisela phambili.
Ingabe ngidinga zonke lezi zindlela ukuze ngixazulule i-Sudoku?

Ezimfumbeni ezilula nezimaphakathi, ababodwa banele. Izimfumbe ezinzima zengeza abalingani abakhiyiwe namaqoqo amancane. Izimfumbe zochwepheshe zidinga okungenani inhlanzi eyodwa noma iphiko elilodwa, kodwa ngokuvamile kanye noma kabili kuphela emfumbeni ngayinye.
Zikhona yini izindlela ezinzima kune-XYZ-Wing?

Yebo, isibonelo amaketango, izivivinyo zobungqayizivele namanetha okuphoqa. I-Bare Sudoku ayidali izimfumbe ezizidingayo, ngakho yonke imfumbe emdlalweni ingaqedwa ngezindlela eziyisishiyagalolunye ezikuleli khasi.
Uyini umlingani?

Inombolo esengangena eselini elingenalutho ngoba akukho okusemugqeni walo, ekholomu lalo noma ebhokisini lalo okuyivimbelayo okwamanje. Amanothi emdlalweni angabalingani. Yonke indlela engaphezu kwababodwa icabanga ngabalingani, ngakho bagcine bephelele futhi benembile.

naked-single.name: Oyedwa osobala
naked-single.title: Oyedwa osobala ku-Sudoku: iseli elinomlingani oyedwa
naked-single.description: Oyedwa osobala yiseli elingenalutho elinenombolo eyodwa kuphela engangena. Funda ukubathola ngokushesha, ngesibonelo sangempela namaphutha avamile.
naked-single.summary: Oyedwa osobala yiseli elingenalutho elinomlingani oyedwa ncamashi: ezinye izinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili sezivele zikhona emugqeni walo, ekholomu lalo noma ebhokisini lalo. Inombolo esele kufanele ingene lapho. Yindlela elula kakhulu ye-Sudoku, oyisebenzisa kakhulu, futhi isexwayiso se-Bare Sudoku siyibika ngokuthi “Mlingani oyedwa kuphela lapha”.
when: Njalo. Oyedwa osobala uvela kusukela esinyathelweni sokuqala kuya kwesokugcina, kuwo wonke amazinga. Ezimfumbeni ezilula nezimaphakathi, kanye noyedwa ofihlekile, uyindlela okuwukuphela kwayo oyidingayo. Ezimfumbeni ezinzima, ukususa ngakunye okwenziwe yindlela ethuthukile ngokuvamile kushiya oyedwa osobala, ngakho mfune ngemva kwesinyathelo ngasinye.
spot: Bheka amaseli anomakhelwane abaningi asebefakelwe izinombolo: iseli emugqeni osunezinombolo eziyisikhombisa, noma iseli umugqa walo, ikholomu lalo nebhokisi lalo okuhlanganisa izinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kwamanothi, bala izinombolo ongazibona usuka eselini. Ngamanothi, oyedwa osobala umane abe yiseli elibonisa umlingani oyedwa, yingakho inkinobho ethi Gcwalisa amanothi yenza kube lula ukubathola.

steps: Bheka iseli {cell}. Alinalutho, ngakho bhala zonke izinombolo esezifakiwe emugqeni walo, ekholomu lalo nasebhokisini lalo.
Umugqa {row} unezinombolo {rowDigits}. Ikholomu {col} linezinombolo {colDigits}. Ibhokisi {box} linezinombolo {boxDigits}.
Ndawonye zikhipha zonke izinombolo ngaphandle kuka-{d}, ngakho inombolo {d} iyona kuphela umlingani osele eselini {cell}.
Bhala inombolo {d} eselini {cell}. Bese uhlola ukuthi inombolo entsha idala yini omunye oyedwa emugqeni ofanayo, ekholomu elifanayo noma ebhokisini elifanayo.

mistakes: Ukubala umugqa kuphela noma ibhokisi kuphela. Izinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili ezikhishiwe ngokuvamile zivela kuwo womathathu amayunithi ndawonye.
Ukukhohlwa ukuthi inombolo osanda kuyifaka nayo ikhipha abalingani komakhelwane bayo abangu-20; ngemva kokufaka ngakunye kuvela ngokushesha abasha abayedwa abasobala.
Ukudida oyedwa osobala noyedwa ofihlekile: oyedwa osobala unomlingani oyedwa osele eselini, oyedwa ofihlekile unendawo eyodwa esele yenombolo eyunithini.
faq: Uyini oyedwa osobala ku-Sudoku?

Iseli elingenalutho elinomlingani oyedwa ncamashi. Izinombolo eziyisishiyagalombili ezahlukene sezivele zifakiwe emugqeni walo, ekholomu lalo nasebhokisini lalo, ngakho inombolo yesishiyagalolunye iyona kuphela engena.
Kungani kuthiwa osobala?

Ngoba umlingani oyedwa ubonakala ngqo eselini uma amanothi esebhaliwe; akukho okumfihlayo. Oyedwa ofihlekile yena uhlala phakathi kwabanye abalingani futhi utholakala ngokubheka inombolo kunokubheka iseli.
Ingabe imfumbe ingaxazululwa ngoyedwa osobala kuphela?

Izimfumbe eziningi ezilula zingakwazi, kodwa eziningi zidinga noyedwa ofihlekile. I-Bare Sudoku ilinganisa izimfumbe ezilula nezimaphakathi njengezixazululeka ngazo zombili izinhlobo zababodwa; izimfumbe ezinzima nezochwepheshe zidinga okungenani enye indlela.
Ingabe isexwayiso sibonisa oyedwa osobala?
Yebo. Uma ukufaka okulandelayo kungoyedwa osobala, isexwayiso sikhetha iseli futhi sithi “Mlingani oyedwa kuphela lapha” kanye nenombolo. Thinta isexwayiso futhi ukuze uyifake.

hidden-single.name: Oyedwa ofihlekile
hidden-single.title: Oyedwa ofihlekile ku-Sudoku: indawo eyodwa yenombolo
hidden-single.description: Oyedwa ofihlekile yiseli okuwukuphela kwalo emugqeni, ekholomu noma ebhokisini lapho inombolo isengangena khona. Funda ukubabona ngokuhlola inombolo eyodwa.
hidden-single.summary: Oyedwa ofihlekile yinombolo enendawo eyodwa kuphela esele emugqeni, ekholomu noma ebhokisini, ngisho noma lelo seli libonisa abanye abalingani. Njengoba iyunithi kufanele ibe nale nombolo, ingena lapho. Isexwayiso se-Bare Sudoku siyibika ngokuthi “Indawo eyodwa kuphela ye-5 kulo mugqa”, noma kuleli kholomu noma kuleli bhokisi.
when: Lapho inombolo isiqhubeke kakhulu: uma inombolo isivele kahlanu noma kasithupha, amabhokisi asele avinjelwe kakhulu, futhi oyedwa ofihlekile uvame ukuba yisinyathelo esilandelayo. Oyedwa ofihlekile uyindlela eyinhloko yezimfumbe ezilula nezimaphakathi futhi uhlala eyindlela esetshenziswa kakhulu kuwo wonke amazinga.
spot: Hlola inombolo eyodwa ngesikhathi. Thatha inombolo, uthole ibhokisi elingenayo, bese ucisha wonke amaseli aleli bhokisi ahlanganyela umugqa noma ikholomu nekhophi efakiwe yaleyo nombolo. Uma kusala iseli elilodwa, usumtholile oyedwa ofihlekile. Ukuhlola okufanayo kusebenza nasemigqeni nasemakholomu. Emdlalweni, thinta inombolo efakiwe: wonke amakhophi ayo ayagqanyiswa, ngakho amaseli angenalutho ayagqama.

steps: Ibhokisi {box} alikabi nayo inombolo {d}, ngakho elinye lamaseli alo angenalutho kufanele libe nayo. Amaseli angenalutho yilawa: {empties}.
Kuwo wonke ngaphandle kweseli {cell}, inombolo {d} ivinjwe yinombolo {d} esivele ifakiwe emugqeni ofanayo noma ekholomu elifanayo, ngakho inombolo {d} ayikho phakathi kwabalingani lapho.
Lokho kushiya iseli {cell} njengendawo eyodwa kuphela yenombolo {d} ebhokisini {box}. Bhala inombolo {d} lapho, ngisho noma iseli {cell} lisabonisa abanye abalingani.

mistakes: Ukufaka inombolo eselini okungenzeka nje ukuthi yilo elifanele: hlola wonke amanye amaseli angenalutho aleyo yunithi, hhayi nje lawo asobala.
Ukugeja oyedwa ofihlekile ngoba iseli libonisa abalingani abaningana. Abanye abalingani abanandaba; okubalulekile ukuthi inombolo ayinayo enye indawo eyunithini.
Ukuhlola amabhokisi kuphela. Imigqa namakholomu kuveza oyedwa ofihlekile kaningi ngokufanayo, ikakhulukazi ngasekupheleni.
faq: Uyini oyedwa ofihlekile ku-Sudoku?
Inombolo engangena eselini elilodwa kuphela lomugqa, lekholomu noma lebhokisi. Iyunithi kufanele ibe nale nombolo, ngakho iseli linqumekile ngisho noma lisenabanye abalingani.
Uyini umehluko phakathi koyedwa ofihlekile noyedwa osobala?
Oyedwa osobala umayelana neseli: kusele umlingani oyedwa. Oyedwa ofihlekile umayelana nenombolo: kusele iseli elilodwa eyunithini. Bobabili bafaka inombolo ngokuqiniseka.
Yimuphi okulula ukumthola?

Ngaphandle kwamanothi, oyedwa ofihlekile uvame ukuba lula ngoba ungahlola ibhodi inombolo eyodwa ngesikhathi. Ngamanothi aphelele, oyedwa osobala ulula kakhulu, ngoba iseli elinomlingani oyedwa liyagqama.
Isexwayiso simchaza kanjani oyedwa ofihlekile?
Isexwayiso sithi “Indawo eyodwa kuphela” yenombolo kulo mugqa, kuleli kholomu noma kuleli bhokisi, futhi sikhethe iseli. Thinta isexwayiso futhi ukuze uyifake.

locked-candidates.name: Abalingani abakhiyiwe
locked-candidates.title: Abalingani abakhiyiwe ku-Sudoku: ukukhomba nokubanga
locked-candidates.description: Abalingani abakhiyiwe: uma abalingani benombolo ebhokisini bonke besemugqeni owodwa noma ekholomu elilodwa, noma okuphambene, inombolo isuswa kwenye indawo.
locked-candidates.summary: Abalingani abakhiyiwe yindlela yokuqala esusa abalingani esikhundleni sokufaka inombolo. Inezinhlobo ezimbili. Ukukhomba: ebhokisini, bonke abalingani benombolo basemugqeni owodwa noma ekholomu elilodwa, ngakho inombolo isuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yalowo mugqa noma lelo kholomu. Ukubanga: emugqeni noma ekholomu, bonke abalingani benombolo basebhokisini elilodwa, ngakho inombolo isuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yalelo bhokisi. Isexwayiso se-Bare Sudoku sibiza ukufaka esikuvulayo ngokuthi “Abalingani abakhiyiwe”.
when: Uma ababodwa bephela emfumbeni enzima, lokhu kuyinto yokuqala okufanele uyizame. Kudinga amanothi aphelele okungenani enombolo oyihlolayo. Abalingani abakhiyiwe bavamile: izimfumbe eziningi ezinzima ziyabadinga, futhi izimfumbe zochwepheshe zibasebenzisa phakathi kwamaphethini amakhulu.
spot: Ukuze uthole ukukhomba, bheka ibhokisi ngalinye nenombolo ngayinye engekho kulo: uma amaseli abalingani baleyo nombolo esemugqeni owodwa noma ekholomu elilodwa, hlola ukuthi inombolo efanayo ivela yini njengomlingani phambili kulowo mugqa noma kulelo kholomu ngaphandle kwebhokisi. Ukuze uthole ukubanga, bheka ngobude bomugqa noma bekholomu: uma bonke abalingani benombolo bengaphakathi kwebhokisi elilodwa, amanye amaseli alelo bhokisi angahlanzwa. Emdlalweni, thinta inkinobho yenombolo ukuze ugqamise bonke abalingani bayo; amanothi amabili noma amathathu agqanyisiwe asemugqeni owodwa noma ekholomu elilodwa ngaphakathi kwebhokisi elilodwa ayiphethini.

steps: Ebhokisini {box}, inombolo {d} inalawa maseli abalingani kuphela: {cells}. Onke asemugqeni {row}.
Ibhokisi {box} lidinga inombolo {d}, ngakho inombolo {d} yomugqa {row} ingaphakathi kwebhokisi {box}, noma ngabe ingena kuliphi kulawo maseli.
Umugqa {row} awukwazi ukuba nenombolo {d} yesibili, ngakho susa inombolo {d} emaselini omugqa {row} angaphandle kwebhokisi: {elim}.
Emugqeni {row}, inombolo {d} ingangena emaselini {cells} kuphela, futhi onke angaphakathi kwebhokisi {box}.
Umugqa {row} kufanele ube nenombolo {d}, ngakho inombolo {d} yebhokisi {box} ibangwa ngumugqa {row}. Amanye amaseli ebhokisi {box} awakwazi ukuba nenombolo {d}.
Susa inombolo {d} emaselini {elim}.

mistakes: Ukususa inombolo ngaphakathi kwebhokisi esikhundleni sangaphandle kwalo esimweni sokukhomba, noma okuphambene esimweni sokubanga. Ukususa kuhlale kuya emaselini asemugqeni noma ekholomu kodwa angekho ebhokisini, noma asebhokisini kodwa angekho kulowo mugqa noma kulelo kholomu.
Ukusebenzisa umthetho lapho abalingani besemigqeni emibili yebhokisi. Wonke amaseli abalingani benombolo ebhokisini kufanele abe semugqeni owodwa noma ekholomu elilodwa.
Ukukhohlwa ukufuna oyedwa odalwa ukususa. Abalingani abakhiyiwe abavamile ukufaka inombolo bebodwa; balungiselela oyedwa.
faq: Yini abalingani abakhiyiwe ku-Sudoku?

Abalingani benombolo abavalelwe endaweni lapho ibhokisi nomugqa noma ikholomu kuhlangana khona. Njengoba ibhokisi, noma umugqa noma ikholomu, kufanele kube nale nombolo kuleyo ndawo, inombolo ingasuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yomugqa noma yekholomu, noma kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yebhokisi.
Uyini umehluko phakathi kokukhomba nokubanga?

Ukukhomba kuqala ebhokisini: abalingani benombolo ebhokisini bakhomba ngobude bomugqa owodwa noma bekholomu elilodwa, ngakho inombolo isuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yawo. Ukubanga kuqala emugqeni noma ekholomu: abalingani balowo mugqa noma lelo kholomu benombolo bonke basebhokisini elilodwa, ngakho umugqa noma ikholomu libanga inombolo futhi isuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yebhokisi.
Ingabe abalingani abakhiyiwe babizwa nangokuthi intersection removal?
Yebo. Amanye amagama yi-box-line reduction yohlobo lokubanga kanye ne-pointing pairs noma i-pointing triples yohlobo lokukhomba. I-Bare Sudoku isebenzisa igama elilodwa kukho kokubili.
Yiliphi izinga elidinga abalingani abakhiyiwe?
Kunzima. Imfumbe edinga abalingani abakhiyiwe noma amaqoqo amancane kodwa ingadingi lutho olunzima kakhulu ifakwa ezingeni elithi Kunzima; izimfumbe zochwepheshe zidinga nenhlanzi noma iphiko.

naked-pairs.name: Ababili nabathathu abasobala
naked-pairs.title: Ababili nabathathu abasobala ku-Sudoku: basebenza kanjani
naked-pairs.description: Ababili nabathathu abasobala: amaseli amabili noma amathathu eyunithini anabalingani ababili noma abathathu abafanayo. Funda ukubabona nokuthi yini oyisusayo.
naked-pairs.h1: Ababili nabathathu abasobala (naked pairs, naked triples)
naked-pairs.summary: Ababili abasobala ngamaseli amabili emugqeni ofanayo, ekholomu elifanayo noma ebhokisini elifanayo anabalingani ababili abafanayo ncamashi. Lezi zinombolo ezimbili kufanele zingene kulawo maseli amabili, ngakho zingasuswa kuwo wonke amanye amaseli eyunithi. Abathathu abasobala ngumqondo ofanayo ngamaseli amathathu nezinombolo ezintathu; iseli ngalinye lingabonisa ezimbili noma zontathu. Isexwayiso se-Bare Sudoku sibiza ukufaka okulandelayo ngokuthi “Ababili noma abathathu”.
when: Ngemva kokuba amanothi esephelele futhi ababodwa nabalingani abakhiyiwe sebephelile. Ababili abasobala bavame kakhulu ezimfumbeni ezinzima, abathathu abasobala kancane. Kufanelekile ukubafuna bobabili kuyo yonke iyunithi esenamaseli angenalutho amahlanu noma ngaphezulu.
spot: Funa amaseli anabalingani ababili kuphela, bese uthola elinye iseli kuyunithi efanayo elinabo labo ababili. Kwabathathu, bheka amayunithi anamaseli amaningana anabalingani ababili noma abathathu, bese uhlola ukuthi amathathu awo ndawonye asebenzisa izinombolo ezintathu ezahlukene kuphela yini. Amaseli anabalingani abafanayo ncamashi kulula ukuwabona uma amanothi esebhaliwe; inkinobho ethi Gcwalisa amanothi emdlalweni ikwenza lokho ngokuthinta okukodwa.

steps: {cellA} ne-{cellB} {unit} anabalingani ababili abafanayo ncamashi: {d1} no-{d2}.
Elinye lawo kufanele libe ngu-{d1} bese elinye liba ngu-{d2}. Asazi ukuthi yiliphi, kodwa zombili izinombolo zisetshenziswa yilawa maseli amabili.
Ngakho alikho elinye iseli {unit} elingaba nenombolo {d1} noma {d2}. Susa {elim}.
Amaseli amathathu {unit} athola bonke abalingani bawo ezinombolweni ezintathu ezifanayo, {digits}: {cells}.

Lezi zinombolo ezintathu kufanele zigcwalise lawa maseli amathathu ngohlelo oluthile. Iseli alidingi ukubonisa bonke abalingani abathathu; okubalulekile ukuthi alikho kulawa maseli amathathu elinomlingani ongaphandle kweqoqo.
Susa izinombolo {digits} kuwo wonke amanye amaseli {unit}: {elim}.

mistakes: Ukuthatha amaseli amabili ahlanganyela abalingani ababili kodwa abuye abe nowesithathu. Kwababili abasobala, iseli ngalinye kufanele libe nalabo balingani ababili ncamashi, lingabi nomunye.
Ukususa izinombolo emaselini ababili ngokwawo. Ababili bagcina abalingani babo; ukususa kuya kwamanye amaseli eyunithi.
Ukufuna ukuthi iseli ngalinye labathathu libonise zontathu izinombolo. Iseli elinezimbili kwezintathu lilungile, inqobo nje uma kungekho seli elinomlingani ongaphandle kweqoqo.
faq: Yini ababili abasobala ku-Sudoku?
Amaseli amabili eyunithini eyodwa, womabili anabalingani ababili abafanayo ncamashi. Lezo zinombolo ezimbili zikhiyiwe kulawo maseli amabili, ngakho zingasuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yeyunithi.
Yini abathathu abasobala?

Amaseli amathathu eyunithini eyodwa abalingani bawo ndawonye bayizinombolo ezintathu kuphela. Iseli ngalinye lingaba nezimbili noma ezintathu zazo. Izinombolo ezintathu zigcwalisa amaseli amathathu, ngakho zingasuswa kwamanye amaseli eyunithi.
Ingabe ababili abasobala bayayifaka inombolo?
Hhayi bebodwa. Basusa abalingani, futhi ukususa ngokuvamile kushiya oyedwa osobala noma ofihlekile. Isexwayiso ku-Bare Sudoku sibonisa lowo oyedwa futhi sisho igama lendlela eyenze kwenzeka.
Ingabe ababili abasobala bangaba sebhokisini nasemugqeni ngesikhathi esisodwa?
Yebo. Uma amaseli amabili ehlanganyela umugqa nebhokisi, ababili basusa kuwo womabili amayunithi. I-Bare Sudoku iwasingatha iyunithi eyodwa ngesikhathi.

hidden-pairs.name: Ababili nabathathu abafihlekile
hidden-pairs.title: Ababili nabathathu abafihlekile ku-Sudoku: ukubabona
hidden-pairs.description: Ababili abafihlekile yizinombolo ezimbili ezingangena emaselini amabili afanayo eyunithini kuphela, ngakho abanye abalingani bawo bayasuswa. Funda ukubathola.
hidden-pairs.h1: Ababili nabathathu abafihlekile (hidden pairs, hidden triples)
hidden-pairs.summary: Ababili abafihlekile yizinombolo ezimbili okuthi, ngaphakathi komugqa owodwa, ikholomu elilodwa noma ibhokisi elilodwa, zibe ngabalingani emaselini amabili afanayo kuphela hhayi kwenye indawo. Lawo maseli amabili kufanele abe nalezo zinombolo ezimbili, ngakho bonke abanye abalingani kuwo bangasuswa. Abathathu abafihlekile basebenza ngendlela efanayo ngezinombolo ezintathu ezivalelwe emaselini amathathu. Ngemva kokususa, amaseli abonisa ababili noma abathathu abasobala. Isexwayiso se-Bare Sudoku sibiza ukufaka okulandelayo ngokuthi “Ababili noma abathathu”.
when: Uma iyunithi inamaseli anabalingani abaningi futhi ababodwa sebephelile. Ababili abafihlekile bacasha emaselini aminyene, yingakho kufanelekile ukubafuna khona kanye lapho ababili abasobala bengabonakali khona. Abathathu abafihlekile bayivelakancane; i-Bare Sudoku iyabafuna, kodwa izimfumbe eziningi ezinzima ziyaxazululwa ngaphandle kwabo.
spot: Sebenza ngenombolo, hhayi ngeseli. Eyunithini, qaphela amaseli lapho inombolo ngayinye engekho ingangena khona. Uma izinombolo ezimbili ngayinye inamaseli amabili kuphela angaba khona futhi kungamaseli amabili afanayo, usubatholile ababili abafihlekile. Emdlalweni, thinta inkinobho yenombolo ukuze ugqamise abalingani bayo; uma izinombolo ezimbili zikhanyisa amaseli amabili afanayo eyunithi futhi zingakhanyisi lutho olunye kuyo, leyo yiphethini.

steps: Izinombolo {d1} no-{d2} {unit} ngayinye inamaseli amabili kuphela angaba khona, futhi angamaseli amabili afanayo: {cells}.
Lawo maseli amabili kufanele abe nezinombolo {d1} no-{d2}, ngakho abanye abalingani bawo abakwazi ukuba khona.
Susa {elim}. Manje amaseli amabili abonisa ababili abasobala, okungavula okunye.

mistakes: Ukususa izinombolo ezimbili zababili emaselini abo. Kususwa abanye abalingani balawo maseli; izinombolo zababili ziyasala.
Ukwamukela inombolo enendawo yesithathu engaba khona eyunithini. Zombili izinombolo kufanele zivalelwe emaselini amabili ncamashi.
Ukubheka emabhokisini kuphela. Ababili abafihlekile bavela kaningi ngokufanayo emigqeni nasemakholomu.
faq: Yini ababili abafihlekile ku-Sudoku?
Izinombolo ezimbili ezingangena emaselini amabili afanayo eyunithi kuphela. Lawo maseli kufanele athathe lezo zinombolo, ngakho abanye abalingani bawo bayasuswa.
Ababili abafihlekile bahluke kanjani kwababili abasobala?

Ababili abasobala bayabonakala: amaseli amabili abonisa abalingani ababili abafanayo kuphela. Ababili abafihlekile bambozwe ngabalingani abengeziwe emaselini amabili. Uma labo abengeziwe besusiwe, ababili abafihlekile baba ngababili abasobala.
Yini abathathu abafihlekile?

Izinombolo ezintathu ezivalelwe emaselini amathathu eyunithi. Inombolo ngayinye akudingeki ivele kuwo womathathu amaseli; okubalulekile ukuthi ayikho kulezi zinombolo ezintathu enomlingani ngaphandle kwalawo maseli.
Ingabe isexwayiso siyabahlukanisa ababili abafihlekile nabasobala?
Cha. I-Bare Sudoku ithola bobabili futhi ibiza ukufaka okulandelayo ngokuthi “Ababili noma abathathu”. Amakhasi lapha ayabahlukanisa ngoba batholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: I-X-Wing ku-Sudoku: indlela esebenza ngayo
x-wing.description: I-X-Wing: inombolo enamaseli abalingani amabili ncamashi emigqeni emibili, kumakholomu amabili afanayo, isuswa kwamanye amaseli alawo makholomu. Nesibonelo.
x-wing.summary: I-X-Wing iyiphethini yenombolo eyodwa namaseli amane asemakhoneni onxande. Uma inombolo inamaseli abalingani amabili ncamashi emigqeni emibili ngayinye, futhi lawo maseli esemakholomu amabili afanayo, inombolo kufanele ihlale emakhoneni amabili abhekene onxande. Ngakho ingasuswa kuwo wonke amanye amaseli alawo makholomu amabili. Kusebenza ngendlela efanayo uma imigqa namakholomu kushintshaniswa. Yindlela yokuqala yochwepheshe ku-Bare Sudoku.
when: Uma ababodwa, abalingani abakhiyiwe namaqoqo amancane sebephelile. I-X-Wing iyiphethini evame kakhulu yochwepheshe futhi ivame ukuvela lapho inombolo isele nabalingani abambalwa, ngokuvamile lapho amakhophi ayo amane kuya kwayisithupha esefakiwe. Idinga amanothi aphelele enombolo oyihlolayo.
spot: Khetha inombolo bese ufuna imigqa lapho inamaseli abalingani amabili ncamashi. Uma imigqa emibili enjalo ihlanganyela amakholomu amabili afanayo, hlola kulawo makholomu abanye abalingani baleyo nombolo: yibo abazosuswa. Bese uphinda usebenzisa amakholomu njengesisekelo. Emdlalweni, thinta inkinobho yenombolo: bonke abalingani bayo bayagqanyiswa, futhi unxande wamanothi amane agqanyisiwe kulula ukuwubona.

steps: Inombolo {d} inamaseli abalingani amabili ncamashi emugqeni {r1} namabili ncamashi emugqeni {r2}, futhi ahlelekile kumakholomu amabili afanayo, {c1} no-{c2}: {cells}.
Umugqa {r1} ufaka inombolo {d} yawo ekholomu {c1} noma {c2}, kanti umugqa {r2} uyifaka kwelinye. Noma kunjani, amakholomu {c1} no-{c2} ngalinye lithola inombolo {d} kule migqa emibili.
Ngakho inombolo {d} ayikwazi ukuvela kwenye indawo emakholomu {c1} no-{c2}. Susa inombolo {d} emaselini {elim}.

mistakes: Ukusebenzisa umugqa onamaseli abalingani amathathu enombolo. Umugqa ngamunye wesisekelo kufanele ube namabili ncamashi, futhi womabili kufanele abe semakholomu amabili ahlanganyelwayo.
Ukususa inombolo emigqeni esikhundleni sokuyisusa emakholomu. Uma imigqa iyisisekelo, ukususa kwenzeka emakholomu, futhi okuphambene nalokho.
Ukukhohlwa inguqulo eshintshanisiwe. I-X-Wing eyakhelwe emakholomu isusa emigqeni.
faq: Iyini i-X-Wing ku-Sudoku?

Inombolo enamaseli abalingani amabili ncamashi emigqeni emibili ngayinye, kumakholomu amabili afanayo. Inombolo ihlala emakhoneni amabili abhekene alowo nxande, ngakho isuswa kuyo yonke enye ingxenye yamakholomu amabili. Imigqa namakholomu kungashintshaniswa.
Kungani i-X-Wing isebenza?

Umugqa ngamunye kule mibili kufanele ufake inombolo kwelinye lamakholomu amabili, futhi imigqa emibili ayikwazi ukusebenzisa ikholomu elifanayo. Ngakho amakholomu amabili ngalinye lithola ikhophi yalo yenombolo kule migqa, futhi bonke abanye abalingani kulawo makholomu abanakwenzeka.
Ingabe i-X-Wing iyinhlanzi?
Yebo. I-X-Wing iyinhlanzi enosayizi 2; i-Swordfish iyinhlanzi enosayizi 3. I-Bare Sudoku ithola zombili.
Yiliphi izinga elinama-X-Wing?
Uchwepheshe. Imfumbe edinga i-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing, i-Swordfish noma i-XYZ-Wing ifakwa ezingeni elithi Uchwepheshe.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: I-Y-Wing ku-Sudoku: indlela esebenza ngayo
y-wing.description: I-Y-Wing (XY-Wing): insika enabalingani ababili namaphiko amabili, ngalinye lihlanganyela oyedwa wabo, isusa inombolo emaselini abona womabili amaphiko.
y-wing.summary: I-Y-Wing, ebizwa nangokuthi i-XY-Wing, isebenzisa amaseli amathathu, ngalinye linabalingani ababili. Insika inabalingani X no-Y. Iphiko elilodwa libona insika futhi lino-X no-Z; elinye iphiko libona insika futhi lino-Y no-Z. Noma ngabe insika iba yini, elinye lamaphiko kufanele libe ngu-Z, ngakho umlingani Z angasuswa kuwo wonke amaseli abona womabili amaphiko. Yindlela yochwepheshe ku-Bare Sudoku.
when: Uma imfumbe inamaseli amaningana anabalingani ababili ncamashi futhi ingekho inhlanzi etholakalayo. Ama-Y-Wing avamile ezimfumbeni zochwepheshe futhi atholakala ngokulandela amaseli anabalingani ababili: ngalinye lingaba yinsika noma iphiko.
spot: Bhala phansi amaseli anabalingani ababili ncamashi. Kulelo nalelo, lithathe njengensika enabalingani X no-Y, bese ufuna phakathi komakhelwane balo iseli elino-X nenye inombolo Z, neseli elino-Y no-Z ofanayo. Lawo amabili angamaphiko. Bese uthola amaseli abona womabili amaphiko futhi ano-Z. Qaphela ukuthi amaphiko akudingeki abonane.

steps: Insika {pivot} inabalingani {x} no-{y}. Ibona iseli {wingA}, elino-{x} no-{z}, neseli {wingB}, elino-{y} no-{z}.
Uma insika {pivot} ingu-{x}, iseli {wingA} lilahlekelwa ngu-{x} bese liba ngu-{z}. Uma insika {pivot} ingu-{y}, iseli {wingB} liba ngu-{z}. Kuzo zonke izimo elinye lamaphiko amabili lingu-{z}.
Iseli elibona womabili amaphiko alisoze laba ngu-{z}. Susa inombolo {z} emaselini {elim}.

mistakes: Ukukhetha amaphiko angayiboni insika womabili. Iphiko ngalinye kufanele lihlanganyele umugqa, ikholomu noma ibhokisi nensika.
Ukususa u-Z emaselini abona iphiko elilodwa kuphela. Iseli okususwa kulo kufanele libone womabili amaphiko.
Ukususa u-Z ensikeni. Ku-Y-Wing insika ayinayo i-Z; uma inayo, iphethini iyi-XYZ-Wing enemithetho ehlukile.
faq: Iyini i-Y-Wing ku-Sudoku?

Amaseli amathathu anabalingani ababili: insika eno-X no-Y, iphiko elino-X no-Z elibona insika, nephiko elino-Y no-Z elibona insika. Elinye iphiko lihlale lingu-Z, ngakho u-Z uyasuswa emaselini abona womabili amaphiko.
Ingabe i-Y-Wing iyafana ne-XY-Wing?
Yebo. La magama amabili achaza iphethini efanayo. I-Bare Sudoku iyibiza ngokuthi i-Y-Wing.
Kungani elinye iphiko kufanele libe ngu-Z?
Uma insika ingu-X, iphiko lokuqala lilahlekelwa ngu-X bese liba ngu-Z. Uma insika ingu-Y, iphiko lesibili liba ngu-Z. Insika ingenye yalokhu okubili, ngakho elinye iphiko lingu-Z.
I-Y-Wing isusa emaselini amangaki?
Ngokuvamile elilodwa noma amabili: amaseli abona womabili amaphiko futhi asenomlingani Z kuphela. Lokho kwanele ukudala oyedwa.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: I-Swordfish ku-Sudoku: indlela esebenza ngayo
swordfish.description: I-Swordfish: inombolo evalelwe kumakholomu amathathu emigqeni emithathu isuswa kwamanye amaseli alawo makholomu. Inhlanzi enosayizi 3, nesibonelo sangempela.
swordfish.summary: I-Swordfish iyi-X-Wing enemigqa emithathu namakholomu amathathu. Uma inombolo inamaseli abalingani angafika kwamathathu emigqeni emithathu ngayinye, futhi wonke lawo maseli esemakholomu amathathu afanayo, imigqa emithathu iyiqeda inombolo kulawo makholomu, futhi inombolo ingasuswa kuwo wonke amanye amaseli amakholomu amathathu. Imigqa namakholomu kungashintshaniswa. I-Bare Sudoku ifuna i-Swordfish ngemva kwe-Y-Wing, ezimfumbeni zochwepheshe.
when: Uma i-X-Wing ne-Y-Wing zingatholi lutho. Ama-Swordfish awavamile njengama-X-Wing futhi adinga inombolo abalingani bayo abasabalele kancane emigqeni emithathu. Adinga amanothi aphelele nanembile aleyo nombolo.
spot: Khetha inombolo bese ufuna imigqa enamaseli abalingani ayo amabili noma amathathu. Uma imigqa emithathu enjalo ihlanganisa amakholomu amathathu kuphela sekukonke, hlola kulawo makholomu abanye abalingani baleyo nombolo. Akudingeki ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ube nomlingani kulo lonke ikholomu: i-Swordfish ingaba namaseli ayisithupha, ayisikhombisa, ayisishiyagalombili noma ayisishiyagalolunye. Emdlalweni, gqamisa inombolo ngenkinobho yayo bese ufuna imigqa emithathu abalingani bayo abahlelekile emakholomu amathathu.

steps: Inombolo {d} inamaseli abalingani angafika kwamathathu kumugqa ngamunye wemigqa {rows}, futhi wonke lawo maseli asemakholomu {cols}: {cells}.

Umugqa ngamunye kwemithathu kufanele ufake inombolo {d} yawo kwelinye lamakholomu amathathu, futhi ayikho imigqa emibili engasebenzisa ikholomu elifanayo. Ngakho amakholomu amathathu athola inombolo {d} yawo kule migqa emithathu.
Noma yimuphi omunye umlingani {d} emakholomu {cols} akanakwenzeka. Susa inombolo {d} emaselini {elim}.

mistakes: Ukufuna wonke amaseli ayisishiyagalolunye. I-Swordfish enabalingani ababili kweminye imigqa isasebenza, inqobo nje uma imigqa emithathu ihlanganisa amakholomu amathathu kuphela.
Ukufaka umugqa onamaseli abalingani amane. Umugqa ngamunye wesisekelo kufanele ube namathathu noma ngaphansi, onke engaphakathi kwamakholomu amathathu.
Ukususa emigqeni yesisekelo. Uma imigqa iyisisekelo, ukususa kwenzeka emakholomu amathathu, ngaphandle kwemigqa yesisekelo.
faq: Iyini i-Swordfish ku-Sudoku?

Inombolo abalingani bayo emigqeni emithathu bavalelwe kumakholomu amathathu. Imigqa emithathu kufanele ifake inombolo kulawo makholomu amathathu, eyodwa kulinye nalinye, ngakho inombolo isuswa kwamanye amaseli alawo makholomu.
I-Swordfish ihluke kanjani ku-X-Wing?
Ngosayizi kuphela: i-X-Wing isebenzisa imigqa emibili namakholomu amabili, i-Swordfish emithathu namathathu. Ukucabanga kuyafana.
Ingabe i-Swordfish idinga amaseli ayisishiyagalolunye ncamashi?
Cha. Umugqa ngamunye ungaba nabalingani ababili noma abathathu; iphethini idinga kuphela ukuthi imigqa emithathu ndawonye ingasebenzisi amakholomu angaphezu kwamathathu.
Ikhona yini inhlanzi enosayizi 4?
Yebo, i-Jellyfish. I-Bare Sudoku ayiyisebenzisi, ngoba izimfumbe zayo azisoze zayidinga.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: I-XYZ-Wing ku-Sudoku: indlela esebenza ngayo
xyz-wing.description: I-XYZ-Wing: insika enabalingani abathathu namaphiko amabili ahlanganyela oyedwa wabo isusa leyo nombolo emaselini abona womathathu. Nesibonelo sangempela.
xyz-wing.summary: I-XYZ-Wing iyi-Y-Wing enensika enabalingani abathathu. Insika ino-X, Y no-Z; iphiko elilodwa libona insika futhi lino-X no-Z, elinye libona insika futhi lino-Y no-Z. Elinye lalawa maseli amathathu kufanele libe ngu-Z, ngakho u-Z angasuswa kuwo wonke amaseli abona womathathu. Ngoba insika ngokwayo ingaba ngu-Z, iseli okususwa kulo kufanele libone insika kanye nawo womabili amaphiko, okulikhawulela ebhokisini, emugqeni noma ekholomu amaseli ahlanganyela kukho. Yindlela enzima kakhulu esetshenziswa yi-Bare Sudoku.
when: Kuphela uma konke okunye kwehluleka. Ama-XYZ-Wing ayiphethini eyivelakancane kakhulu ku-Bare Sudoku futhi avela ezimfumbeni zochwepheshe kuphela. Wafune lapho iseli elinabalingani abathathu likhona ebhokisini kanye neseli elinabalingani ababili elihlanganyela izinombolo zalo ezimbili.
spot: Qala ngamaseli anabalingani abathathu ncamashi; ngalinye lingaba yinsika. Phakathi komakhelwane balo, funa amaseli amabili anabalingani ababili ngalinye, bonke bethathwe kwabathathu bensika, ahlanganyela inombolo eyodwa ncamashi, Z. Bese ufuna amaseli abona insika nawo womabili amaphiko futhi ano-Z. Empeleni iphiko elilodwa lisebhokisini lensika kanti elinye lisemugqeni wayo noma ekholomu layo, futhi amaseli okususwa kuwo ngamaseli asele alelo bhokisi kulowo mugqa noma kulelo kholomu.

steps: Insika {pivot} inabalingani abathathu: {x}, {y} no-{z}. Ibona iseli {wingA} elino-{x} no-{z}, neseli {wingB} elino-{y} no-{z}.

Uma insika {pivot} ingu-{z}, sekuphelile. Uma ingu-{x}, iseli {wingA} kufanele libe ngu-{z}. Uma ingu-{y}, iseli {wingB} kufanele libe ngu-{z}. Kuzo zonke izimo elinye lalawa maseli amathathu lingu-{z}.
Iseli elibona womathathu alikwazi ukuba ngu-{z}. Susa inombolo {z} emaselini {elim}.

mistakes: Ukususa emaselini abona amaphiko amabili kuphela. Ngokungafani ne-Y-Wing, insika ingaba ngu-Z, ngakho iseli kufanele libone nensika.
Ukusebenzisa amaphiko abalingani bawo bengatholakali bonke phakathi kwabalingani abathathu bensika.
Ukuyididanisa ne-Y-Wing: umehluko ngumlingani wesithathu ensikeni, futhi uyashintsha ukuthi yimaphi amaseli angahlanzwa.
faq: Iyini i-XYZ-Wing ku-Sudoku?

Insika enabalingani X, Y no-Z namaphiko amabili, elilodwa lino-X no-Z elinye lino-Y no-Z, womabili abona insika. Elinye lalawa maseli amathathu lingu-Z, ngakho u-Z uyasuswa emaselini abona womathathu.
I-XYZ-Wing ihluke kanjani ku-Y-Wing?

Insika inabalingani abathathu esikhundleni sababili, kuhlanganise no-Z. Lokho kwenza insika ibe yindawo engaba khona ka-Z, ngakho amaseli abona insika nawo womabili amaphiko kuphela angalahlekelwa ngu-Z.
I-XYZ-Wing ivela kangaki?
Kuyivelakancane. Ku-Bare Sudoku izimfumbe zochwepheshe kuphela ezingayidinga, futhi eziningi azidingi. I-Bare Sudoku iyihlola ekugcineni, ngemva kwe-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing ne-Swordfish.
Ikhona yini i-WXYZ-Wing?
Yebo, enensika enabalingani abane, kodwa i-Bare Sudoku ayiyisebenzisi. Yonke imfumbe emdlalweni ingaqedwa ngezindlela eziyisishiyagalolunye zalo mhlahlandlela.

af.learnText: Nuut met Sudoku, of vas by 'n moeilike raaisel? Twee gidse verduidelik die reëls en elke oplostegniek wat die wenke gebruik, elkeen met 'n regte voorbeeld.
