Lambarrada la bixiyay, ee farta adag ku qoran, waa kuwo go'an. Shaqadaadu waa inaad buuxiso unugyada bannaan. Xisaab ma jirto, kala horreyn ma jirto: lambarradu waa sagaal calaamadood oo kala duwan oo keliya. Haddii aad xarfo ama qaabab ku ciyaarto, waxba isma beddeleen.

sections.h: Sidee bay u habaysan tahay shabakaddu?
p: Shabakaddu waxay leedahay 81 unug oo ku yaal 9 saf iyo 9 tiir. Xarriijimo waaweyn ayaa u kala qaybiya sagaal sanduuq oo 3×3 ah. Unug kastaa wuxuu ka tirsan yahay hal saf, hal tiir iyo hal sanduuq oo keliya, saddexdaas kooxoodna waa kooxihiisa. 20-ka unug ee kale ee koox la wadaaga unug waxaa loo yaqaan derisyadiisa; lambar la dhigo unug wuxuu lambarkaas ka saaraa dhammaan 20-ka deris.

Unugyada waxaa loo qoraa sida r3c7: safka 3, tiirka 7. Safafka waxaa laga tiriyaa xagga sare, tiirarka xagga bidix, sanduuqyadana 1 ilaa 9 laga bilaabo geeska sare ee bidix, saf saf. Qoraalkan waxaa lagu isticmaalaa hage kasta oo farsamo, waana mid mudan in la barto: r5c5 waa bartamaha shabakadda.

sections.h: Muxuu Sudoku kastaa u leeyahay hal xal oo keliya?
p: Sudoku sax ah wuxuu leeyahay hal xal, taasina waa waxa caqliga ka dhigaya mid shaqeeya. Mar kasta oo aad muujin karto in lambar uusan meel kale ka geli karin koox, waa inuu galaa unugga haray, maxaa yeelay xalku wuu jiraa waana mid keliya. Haddii halxiraale laba xal lahaan lahaa, sababayn kastaa ma kala saari kareen, waxaadna meel uun ku qasbanaan lahayd inaad qiyaasto.

Bare Sudoku wuxuu halxiraale kasta ku sameeyaa qalabkaaga, wuxuuna hubiyaa inuu leeyahay hal xal oo keliya iyo in xalliyihiisa caqliga ahi ku dhammayn karo farsamooyinka heerka la doortay. Markaa haddii aad xayirato, had iyo jeer waxaa jira tallaabo xigta oo la heli karo, tilmaantuna way ku tusinaysaa.
Ka bilow meesha ugu cidhiidhiga badan. Kala horreyntan waxay shaqaysaa heer kasta:
list: Dooro lambar hore u soo muuqday marar badan, tusaale ahaan lix ama toddoba jeer, oo raadi sanduuqyada weli uu ka maqan yahay. Inta badan sanduuq hal unug oo keliya ayaa u haray: taasi waa [keli qarsoon](hidden-single).

Raadi unugyo ay lambarro badan ku hareeraysan yihiin. Unug uu safkiisa, tiirkiisa iyo sanduuqiisu wadajir u leeyihiin siddeed lambar oo kala duwan wuxuu leeyahay hal musharrax oo keliya: [keli muuqda](naked-single). Unugyada ku jira safaf ama sanduuqyo ku dhow buuxsamid ayaa ah meesha ugu fiican ee la eego.
Lambar kasta oo aad dhigto wuxuu musharrax ka saaraa 20 deris, markaa isla markiiba hubi derisyadaas. Kelinimadu badanaa si silsilad ah ayay isugu xigtaa.

Marka dhigista fudud ay dhammaato, qor qoraallada: musharraxiinta unug kasta oo bannaan. Kadib raadi lambar sanduuq dhexdiisa ku xiran hal xariiq ([musharraxiin xiran](locked-candidates)) ama laba unug oo leh isla labada musharrax ([lammaane muuqda](naked-pairs)).
Ku noqo kelinimada ka dib saarid kasta. Xitaa halxiraalayaasha Khabiir inta badan waxaa lagu xalliyaa kelinimo; farsamada horumarsan waxay kaliya furtaa tallaabada xigta.

p: Qoraallada, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan calaamadaha qalinka ama musharraxiinta, waa lambarrada yaryar ee aad ku qorto unug bannaan si aad u diiwaangeliso lambarrada weli halkaas suurtagalka ka ah. Halxiraalayaasha fudud dhif ayaad u baahan tahay; laga bilaabo Adag iyo wixii ka sarreeya waa lagama maarmaan, maxaa yeelay farsamooyinka sida laba iyo saddex, X-Wing iyo Y-Wing waxay ku saabsan yihiin musharraxiinta, ee kuma saabsana lambarrada la dhigay.

Qoraallada ha ahaadaan kuwo sax ah: marka aad lambar dhigto, ka tirtir qoraallada dhammaan 20-ka deris. Bare Sudoku gudihiisa tani si otomaatig ah ayay u dhacdaa, Buuxi qoraalladuna waxay hal taabasho ku qortaa musharrax kasta unug kasta oo bannaan, si aad uga bilaabato musharraxiin dhammaystiran oo sax ah. Qoraalku waa xaqiiq, ma aha qiyaas: wuxuu ka dhigan yahay in aan wax weli meesha ka saarin lambarkan.

Marka hore mar kale hubi aasaaska: saf, tiir iyo sanduuq kasta oo ku dhow buuxsamid waa il kelinimo. Kadib hubi in qoraalladu dhammaystiran yihiin, maxaa yeelay musharrax maqan wuxuu qariyaa qaababka, mid duugoobayna wuxuu abuuraa qaabab been ah. Kadib u mar [farsamooyinka](techniques) sida ay u kala adag yihiin: musharraxiin xiran, laba iyo saddex, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish iyo XYZ-Wing. Mid kastaa bog u gaar ah oo tusaale dhab ah leh ayuu leeyahay.

Haddii aysan waxba shaqayn, qaado tilmaan. Bare Sudoku gudihiisa tilmaantu marka hore waxay hubisaa in lambar la dhigay uu khalad yahay, kadib waxay helaysaa unugga xiga ee caqli lagu buuxin karo waxayna sheegtaa farsamada, si aad wax u barato xitaa marka aad isticmaasho. Mar kale taabo tilmaanta si aad lambarka u dhigto.

sections.h: Sidee lambarrada loogu geliyaa Bare Sudoku?
p: Taabo unug, kadibna lambar. Ama marka hore taabo lambar: wuu xirmaa, unug kasta oo aad taabtana wuu helaa, taasoo ah habka ugu dhakhsaha badan ee lagu dhigo nuqulka lixaad, toddobaad iyo siddeedaad ee lambar. Mar kale taabo lambarka si aad u furto. Badhanka Qoraallo wuxuu u beddelaa calaamadaha qalinka, Tirtir wuxuu nadiifiyaa unug, Noqo wuxuu celiyaa dhaqaaq kasta, khaladaadkana waxaa lagu calaamadiyaa casaan haddii aadan taas ka damin menu-ga.

Kiiboodhka, isticmaal furayaasha fallaadha si aad u dhaqaaqdo, 1 ilaa 9 si aad lambar u geliso, Backspace si aad u tirtirto, N qoraallada, U si aad u noqoto, H tilmaan, F si aad qoraallada u buuxiso iyo Escape menu-ga. Ciyaartu iskeed ayay u kaydsataa, internet la'aan ayay shaqaysaa, xayeysiis iyo akoon midna ma laha.

faq: Ma u baahan tahay inaad qiyaasto Sudoku?

Halxiraale sax ah uma baahna. Halxiraale kasta oo Bare Sudoku ah wuxuu leeyahay hal xal oo keliya, waxaana la hubiyay in caqli keliya lagu xallin karo, ilaa farsamooyinka heerkiisa. Haddii aad dareento inaad qiyaasi doonto, musharrax ayaa ka maqan qoraalladaada ama farsamo ayaa sugaysa in la helo.
Lambar ma laba jeer ku jiri karaa saf, tiir ama sanduuq?

Maya. Taasi waa xeerka oo dhan: sagaalka saf, sagaalka tiir iyo sagaalka sanduuq mid kastaa wuxuu leeyahay lambar kasta oo 1 ilaa 9 ah hal mar oo keliya. Haddii laba lambar oo isku mid ah ay wadaagaan koox, ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah waa khalad.
Waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya Fudud, Dhexdhexaad, Adag iyo Khabiir?

Heerka waxaa go'aamiya farsamooyinka uu halxiraaluhu u baahan yahay. Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad waxaa lagu xalliyaa kelinimo oo keliya, Fududna wuxuu ku bilaabmaa ugu yaraan 38 lambar oo la bixiyay. Adag wuxuu u baahan yahay musharraxiin xiran ama laba iyo saddex. Khabiir wuxuu u baahan yahay X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ama XYZ-Wing.
Ma fiican tahay in qoraallo la buuxiyo unug kasta mise qaar keliya?

Halxiraalayaasha Adag iyo Khabiir, buuxi dhammaan: qaababka sida laba iyo saddex, X-Wing iyo Y-Wing waxay soo baxaan oo keliya marka musharrax kasta la qoro. Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad, qoraalladu waa ikhtiyaari, ciyaartoyda badankoodna waxay kaliya raadiyaan kelinimo.
Intee in le'eg ayuu qaataa Sudoku?

Halxiraale Fudud wuxuu qaataa dhawr daqiiqo; halxiraalayaasha Khabiir waxay qaadan karaan labaatan daqiiqo ama ka badan, iyadoo ku xiran sida degdegga ah ee aad u aragto qaabka horumarsan. Bare Sudoku wuxuu muujiyaa saacad, wuu joojiyaa inta menu-gu furan yahay, mana hayo liis tartan, markaa ku ciyaar xawaarahaaga.
Sudoku ma u baahan yahay xisaab?

Maya. Lambarradu waa calaamado oo keliya; isku darid iyo tirin midna kuma jiro. Sagaal calaamadood oo kasta way shaqayn lahaayeen, taasina waa sababta Sudoku uu u yahay halxiraale caqli ee uusan u ahayn halxiraale tiro.

index.title: Farsamooyinka xalinta Sudoku oo tusaalayaal lagu sharxay
index.description: Dhammaan sagaalka farsamo ee xalinta Sudoku, keli muuqda ilaa Swordfish iyo XYZ-Wing, sida tilmaamaha Bare Sudoku u isticmaalaan, mid kastaa tusaale dhab ah.
intro: Sudoku kasta waxaa lagu xallin karaa farsamooyin caqli oo tiro yar. Tusmadan waxay taxaysaa sagaalka farsamo ee uu isticmaalo xalliyaha Bare Sudoku iyo tilmaamihiisu, sida uu xalliyuhu isugu xigxigo: marka hore kelinimada, kadib saaridda hal koox gudaheed, kadib qaabab ku fidsan dhawr saf iyo tiir. Farsamo kastaa waxay leedahay bog u gaar ah oo leh qeexid, sida loo ogaado, tusaale dhab ah oo laga soo qaaday halxiraale la sameeyay iyo khaladaadka caadiga ah.

Heerka halxiraale waxaa go'aamiya farsamada ugu adag ee uu u baahan yahay. Halxiraalayaasha Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad waxay u baahan yihiin kelinimo oo keliya, kuwa Adag waxay u baahan yihiin musharraxiin xiran ama laba iyo saddex, kuwa Khabiirna waxay u baahan yihiin ugu yaraan hal qaab oo ah kalluun (fish) ama baal (wing). Heerku ha ahaado kuu doono, kelinimada ayaa qabata inta badan shaqada; farsamada horumarsan waxay saartaa hal ama laba musharrax, kelinimaduna halkaas ayay ka sii wadaan.
faq: Farsamooyinka Sudoku kala horreyntee ayaan u tijaabiyaa?

Kuwa ugu fudud marka hore: keli muuqda, keli qarsoon, musharraxiin xiran, laba iyo saddex muuqda, laba iyo saddex qarsoon, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. Bare Sudoku isla kala horreyntan ayuu u tijaabiyaa, tilmaantuna had iyo jeer waxay magacawdaa farsamada ugu fudud ee horumar keenta.
Ma u baahanahay dhammaan farsamooyinkan si aan Sudoku u xalliyo?

Halxiraalayaasha Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad, kelinimadu way ku filan tahay. Halxiraalayaasha Adag waxay ku daraan musharraxiin xiran iyo laba iyo saddex. Halxiraalayaasha Khabiir waxay u baahan yihiin ugu yaraan hal kalluun ama hal baal, laakiin badanaa hal ama laba jeer oo keliya halxiraalihiiba.
Ma jiraan farsamooyin ka adag XYZ-Wing?

Haa, tusaale ahaan silsilado, tijaabooyinka xalka keliya ah iyo forcing nets. Bare Sudoku ma sameeyo halxiraalayaal u baahan, markaa halxiraale kasta oo ciyaarta ku jira waxaa lagu dhammayn karaa sagaalka farsamo ee boggan.
Waa maxay musharrax?

Lambar weli geli kara unug bannaan, maxaa yeelay safkiisa, tiirkiisa iyo sanduuqiisa midna weli ma diidin. Qoraallada ciyaarta waa musharraxiin. Farsamo kasta oo ka dambeysa kelinimada waxay ku dhisan tahay musharraxiinta, markaa ha ahaadaan kuwo dhammaystiran oo sax ah.

naked-single.name: Keli muuqda
naked-single.title: Keli muuqda ee Sudoku: unugga leh hal musharrax
naked-single.description: Keli muuqda waa unug bannaan oo leh hal lambar oo suurtagal ah oo keliya. Baro sida si dhakhso ah loo helo, tusaale dhab ah iyo khaladaadka caadiga ah.
naked-single.summary: Keli muuqda waa unug bannaan oo leh hal musharrax oo keliya: siddeedda lambar ee kale waxay horeba ugu jiraan safkiisa, tiirkiisa ama sanduuqiisa. Lambarka haray waa inuu halkaas galaa. Waa farsamada ugu fudud ee Sudoku, tan aad ugu badan isticmaashid, iyo tan tilmaanta Bare Sudoku ay ku sheegto "Hal musharrax oo keliya halkan".
when: Had iyo jeer. Keli muuqda wuxuu soo muuqdaa laga bilaabo dhaqaaqa ugu horreeya ilaa kan ugu dambeeya, heer kasta. Halxiraalayaasha Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad, isaga iyo keli qarsoon ayaa ah farsamada keliya ee aad u baahan tahay. Halxiraalayaasha ka adag, saarid kasta oo farsamo horumarsan samayso badanaa waxay ka tagtaa keli muuqda, markaa raadi ka dib tallaabo kasta.
spot: Eeg unugyada leh derisyo badan oo buuxa: unug ku jira saf horeba u leh toddoba lambar, ama unug uu safkiisa, tiirkiisa iyo sanduuqiisu wadajir u daboolaan siddeed lambar oo kala duwan. Qoraal la'aan, tiri lambarrada aad ka aragto unugga. Qoraallo leh, keli muuqda waa unug muujinaya hal musharrax oo keliya, taasina waa sababta Buuxi qoraallada ay u fududeyso helitaankooda.

steps: Eeg {cell}. Waa bannaan yahay, markaa qor lambar kasta oo horeba loogu dhigay safkiisa, tiirkiisa iyo sanduuqiisa.
Safka {row} waxaa ku jira {rowDigits}. Tiirka {col} waxaa ku jira {colDigits}. Sanduuqa {box} waxaa ku jira {boxDigits}.
Wadajir waxay meesha ka saaraan lambar kasta marka laga reebo {d}, markaa {d} waa musharraxa keliya ee ku haray {cell}.
Lambarka {d} ku qor {cell}. Kadib hubi in lambarka cusubi uu keli kale ka abuurayo isla safka, tiirka ama sanduuqa.

mistakes: Tirinta safka oo keliya ama sanduuqa oo keliya. Siddeedda lambar ee la diiday badanaa waxay ka yimaadaan saddexda koox oo wadajir ah.
Illaawidda in lambar aad hadda dhigtay uu sidoo kale musharraxiin ka saaro 20-kiisa deris; keli muuqda cusub ayaa soo baxa isla marka dhigid kasta ka dib.
Isku qaldidda keli muuqda iyo keli qarsoon: keli muuqda wuxuu leeyahay hal musharrax oo unugga ku haray, keli qarsoonna wuxuu leeyahay hal unug oo lambarka ugu haray koox dhexdeed.
faq: Waa maxay keli muuqda ee Sudoku?
Unug bannaan oo leh hal musharrax oo keliya. Siddeed lambar oo kala duwan ayaa horeba loogu dhigay safkiisa, tiirkiisa iyo sanduuqiisa, markaa lambarka sagaalaad ayaa ah kan keliya ee ku habboon.
Maxaa loogu yeeraa muuqda?

Sababtoo ah musharraxa keliya si toos ah ayuu unugga ugu muuqdaa marka qoraallada la qoro; waxba ma qariyaan. Keli qarsoon, dhanka kale, wuxuu ku dhex jiraa musharraxiin kale, waxaana la helaa iyadoo la eegayo lambarka halkii laga eegi lahaa unugga.
Halxiraale ma lagu xallin karaa keli muuqda oo keliya?

Halxiraalayaal Fudud oo badan waa haa, laakiin badankood waxay sidoo kale u baahan yihiin keli qarsoon. Bare Sudoku wuxuu halxiraalayaasha Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad u qiimeeyaa kuwo lagu xallin karo labada nooc ee kelinimo; halxiraalayaasha Adag iyo Khabiir waxay u baahan yihiin ugu yaraan farsamo kale.
Tilmaantu ma muujisaa keli muuqda?
Haa. Marka dhigista xigta ay tahay keli muuqda, tilmaantu waxay doorataa unugga waxayna tidhaa "Hal musharrax oo keliya halkan" iyo lambarka. Mar kale taabo tilmaanta si aad u dhigto.

hidden-single.name: Keli qarsoon
hidden-single.title: Keli qarsoon ee Sudoku: meesha keliya ee lambar
hidden-single.description: Keli qarsoon waa unugga keliya ee saf, tiir ama sanduuq uu lambar weli geli karo. Baro sida loo helo adigoo shabakadda baaraya hal lambar mar kasta.
hidden-single.summary: Keli qarsoon waa lambar ay saf, tiir ama sanduuq ugu hartay hal unug oo suurtagal ah oo keliya, xitaa haddii unuggaas uu muujinayo musharraxiin kale. Maadaama kooxdu ay tahay inay lambarka yeelato, halkaas ayuu galaa. Tilmaanta Bare Sudoku waxay ku sheegtaa "Meesha keliya ee 5 safkan", tiirkan ama sanduuqan.
when: Mar kasta oo lambar si fiican u horumaray: marka lambar uu shan ama lix jeer soo muuqdo, sanduuqyada haray aad bay u cidhiidhi yihiin, keli qarsoonna badanaa waa dhaqaaqa xiga. Keli qarsoon waa farsamada ugu muhiimsan ee halxiraalayaasha Fudud iyo Dhexdhexaad, heer kastana wuxuu ahaanayaa farsamada shaqada ugu badan qabata.
spot: Baar hal lambar mar kasta. Qaado lambar, hel sanduuq aan lahayn, oo ka xarriiq unug kasta oo sanduuqaas ah oo saf ama tiir la wadaaga nuqul la dhigay oo lambarkaas ah. Haddii hal unug uu haro, waxaad heshay keli qarsoon. Isla baaritaankaas wuxuu u shaqeeyaa safafka iyo tiirarka. Ciyaarta, taabo lambar la dhigay: nuqul kasta oo ka mid ah waa la iftiiminayaa, unugyada bannaanna si cad ayay u soo baxayaan.

steps: Sanduuqa {box} weli ma laha {d}, markaa mid ka mid ah unugyadiisa bannaan waa inuu qaataa. Unugyada bannaan waa {empties}.
Mid kasta oo iyaga ka mid ah marka laga reebo {cell}, {d} waxaa xiraya {d} horeba loogu dhigay isla safka ama tiirka, markaa {d} halkaas musharrax kama aha.
Taasi waxay {cell} ka dhigaysaa meesha keliya ee {d} ku jiri karto sanduuqa {box}. Halkaas ku qor {d}, xitaa haddii {cell} uu weli muujinayo musharraxiin kale.

mistakes: Lambarka oo la dhigo unug laga yaabo inuu sax yahay oo keliya: hubi unug kasta oo bannaan oo kale ee kooxda, ma aha kuwa si cad u muuqda oo keliya.
Keli qarsoon oo laga dhaafo sababtoo ah unuggu wuxuu muujinayaa dhawr musharrax. Musharraxiinta kale muhiim ma aha; waxa muhiimka ah waa in lambarku uusan meel kale ku lahayn kooxda.
Baarista sanduuqyada oo keliya. Safafka iyo tiirarku si la mid ah ayay u bixiyaan keli qarsoon, gaar ahaan dhammaadka.
faq: Waa maxay keli qarsoon ee Sudoku?
Lambar geli kara hal unug oo keliya oo saf, tiir ama sanduuq ah. Kooxdu waa inay lambarka yeelato, markaa unugga waa la go'aamiyay xitaa haddii uu weli leeyahay musharraxiin kale.
Waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya keli qarsoon iyo keli muuqda?
Keli muuqda wuxuu ku saabsan yahay unug: hal musharrax ayaa ku haray. Keli qarsoon wuxuu ku saabsan yahay lambar: hal unug ayaa ugu haray koox dhexdeed. Labaduba waxay dhigaan lambar si hubaal ah.
Kee baa fudud in la helo?

Qoraal la'aan, keli qarsoon ayaa badanaa fudud maxaa yeelay waxaad shabakadda u baari kartaa hal lambar mar kasta. Qoraallo dhammaystiran leh, keli muuqda ayaa ugu fudud, maadaama unug leh hal musharrax uu si cad u muuqdo.
Sidee tilmaantu u sharaxdaa keli qarsoon?
Sida "Meesha keliya ee" lambarka safkan, tiirkan ama sanduuqan, iyadoo unugga la doortay. Mar kale taabo tilmaanta si aad u dhigto.

locked-candidates.name: Musharraxiin xiran
locked-candidates.title: Musharraxiin xiran ee Sudoku: jihayn iyo sheegasho
locked-candidates.description: Musharraxiin xiran: marka musharraxiinta lambar ee sanduuq ay ku jiraan hal saf ama tiir, ama lidkeeda, lambarka meelo kale ayaa laga saaraa. Laba tusaale.
locked-candidates.summary: Musharraxiinta xiran waa farsamada ugu horreysa ee musharraxiin saarta halkii ay lambar dhigi lahayd. Waxay leedahay laba qaab. Jihayn (pointing): sanduuq dhexdiisa, dhammaan musharraxiinta lambar waxay ku jiraan hal saf ama tiir, markaa lambarka waxaa laga saaraa inta ka hartay xariiqdaas. Sheegasho (claiming): saf ama tiir dhexdiisa, dhammaan musharraxiinta lambar waxay ku jiraan hal sanduuq, markaa lambarka waxaa laga saaraa inta ka hartay sanduuqaas. Tilmaanta Bare Sudoku waxay dhigista ay furto ku calaamadisaa "Musharraxiin xiran".
when: Marka kelinimadu ka dhammaato halxiraale Adag, tani waa waxa ugu horreeya ee la isku dayo. Waxay u baahan tahay qoraallo dhammaystiran, ugu yaraan lambarka aad baarayso. Musharraxiinta xiran waa caadi: halxiraalayaasha Adag badankood way u baahan yihiin, halxiraalayaasha Khabiirna waxay isticmaalaan inta u dhexeysa qaababka waaweyn.
spot: Jihaynta, eeg sanduuq kasta iyo lambar kasta oo ka maqan: haddii unugyada musharraxa u ah lambarkaas ay ku jiraan hal saf ama tiir, hubi in isla lambarku uu musharrax ahaan uga muuqdo xariiqdaas meel ka baxsan sanduuqa. Sheegashada, eeg saf ama tiir dhererkiisa: haddii musharraxiinta lambar ay dhammaan ku jiraan hal sanduuq, inta ka hartay sanduuqaas waa la nadiifin karaa. Ciyaarta, taabo furaha lambar si aad u iftiimiso musharrax kasta oo uu leeyahay; xariiq ka kooban laba ama saddex qoraal oo iftiimaya oo hal sanduuq ku jira ayaa ah qaabka.

steps: Sanduuqa {box}, lambarka {d} wuxuu leeyahay unugyadan musharraxa ah oo keliya: {cells}. Dhammaantood waxay ku jiraan safka {row}.
Sanduuqa {box} wuxuu u baahan yahay {d}, markaa lambarka {d} ee safka {row} wuxuu ku jiraa sanduuqa {box}, unugyadaas kii uu doono ha galee.
Safka {row} ma yeelan karo {d} labaad, markaa {d} ka saar unugyada safka {row} ee ka baxsan sanduuqa: {elim}.
Safka {row}, lambarka {d} wuxuu geli karaa {cells} oo keliya, dhammaantoodna waxay ku jiraan sanduuqa {box}.
Safka {row} waa inuu yeeshaa {d}, markaa lambarka {d} ee sanduuqa {box} waxaa sheegta safka {row}. Unugyada kale ee sanduuqa {box} ma yeelan karaan {d}.
Unugyada {elim} ka saar {d}.

mistakes: Jihaynta, lambarka oo laga saaro gudaha sanduuqa halkii laga saari lahaa dibaddiisa, ama lidkeeda sheegashada. Saaridduhu had iyo jeer waxay ku dhacaan unugyada xariiqda ku jira laakiin aan sanduuqa ku jirin, ama sanduuqa ku jira laakiin aan xariiqda ku jirin.
Xeerka oo la adeegsado marka musharraxiintu ay ku kala firirsan yihiin laba saf oo sanduuqa ah. Dhammaan unugyada musharraxa u ah lambarka ee sanduuqa waa inay ku jiraan hal xariiq.
Illaawidda in la raadiyo keliga ay saariddu abuurto. Musharraxiinta xiran dhif ayay keligood lambar u dhigaan; waxay diyaariyaan keli.
faq: Waa maxay musharraxiinta xiran ee Sudoku?

Musharraxiinta lambar ee ku koobnaaday isgoyska sanduuq iyo xariiq. Maadaama sanduuqa, ama xariiqda, ay tahay inay lambarka ku yeeshaan isgoyskaas, lambarka waa laga saari karaa inta ka hartay xariiqda, ama inta ka hartay sanduuqa.
Waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya jihaynta iyo sheegashada?

Jihayntu waxay ka bilaabataa sanduuq: musharraxiinta lambarka ee sanduuqa waxay u jeedaan hal saf ama tiir, markaa lambarka waxaa laga saaraa inta ka hartay xariiqdaas. Sheegashadu waxay ka bilaabataa saf ama tiir: musharraxiinta xariiqda ee lambarka dhammaan waxay ku jiraan hal sanduuq, markaa xariiqdu waxay lambarka u sheegataa nafteeda, waxaana laga saaraa inta ka hartay sanduuqa.
Musharraxiinta xiran ma sidoo kale waxaa loo yaqaan intersection removal?
Haa. Magacyada kale waa box-line reduction qaabka sheegashada, iyo pointing pairs ama pointing triples qaabka jihaynta. Bare Sudoku wuxuu labadaba u isticmaalaa hal magac.
Heerkee ayaa u baahan musharraxiin xiran?

Adag. Halxiraale u baahan musharraxiin xiran ama laba iyo saddex, laakiin aan u baahnayn wax ka adag, waxaa lagu qiimeeyaa Adag; halxiraalayaasha Khabiir waxay sidoo kale u baahan yihiin kalluun ama baal.

naked-pairs.name: Laba iyo saddex muuqda
naked-pairs.title: Laba iyo saddex muuqda ee Sudoku: sida ay u shaqeeyaan
naked-pairs.description: Laba iyo saddex muuqda: laba ama saddex unug oo koox ah oo wadaaga isla laba ama saddex musharrax. Baro sida loo arko iyo waxa la saaro, tusaalayaal dhab ah.
naked-pairs.h1: Laba iyo saddex muuqda (naked pairs)
naked-pairs.summary: Lammaane muuqda waa laba unug oo ku jira isla saf, tiir ama sanduuq oo leh isla labada musharrax oo keliya. Labada lambar waa inay galaan labadaas unug, markaa waa laga saari karaa unug kasta oo kale oo kooxda ah. Saddex muuqda waa isla fikradda oo leh saddex unug iyo saddex lambar; unug kastaa wuxuu muujin karaa laba ama dhammaan saddexda. Tilmaanta Bare Sudoku waxay dhigista ka dhalata ku calaamadisaa "Laba ama saddex".
when: Marka qoraalladu dhammaystiran yihiin, kelinimada iyo musharraxiinta xiranna ay dhammaadeen. Lammaanayaasha muuqda aad bay ugu badan yihiin halxiraalayaasha Adag, saddexda muuqdana way ka yar yihiin. Labadaba waa mudan tahay in lagu hubiyo koox kasta oo weli leh shan unug oo bannaan ama ka badan.
spot: Raadi unugyo leh laba musharrax oo keliya oo hel unug kale oo isla kooxda ku jira oo leh isla labadaas. Saddexda, eeg kooxaha leh dhawr unug oo leh laba iyo saddex musharrax oo hubi in saddex ka mid ah ay wadajir u isticmaalaan saddex lambar oo kala duwan oo keliya. Unugyada leh isla musharraxiinta way fududdahay in la arko marka qoraallada la qoro; Buuxi qoraallada ee ciyaarta waxay taas ku samaysaa hal taabasho.

steps: {cellA} iyo {cellB} ({unit}) waxay leeyihiin isla labada musharrax oo keliya: {d1} iyo {d2}.
Mid ka mid ah waa inuu noqdaa {d1}, kan kalena {d2}. Ma ogin kee yahay kee, laakiin labada lambarba waxaa qaatay labadan unug.
Sidaa darteed unug kale oo kooxdan ({unit}) ah ma yeelan karo {d1} ama {d2}. Ka saar {elim}.
Saddex unug oo kooxdan ({unit}) ah ayaa dhammaan musharraxiintooda ka qaata isla saddexda lambar, {digits}: {cells}.

Saddexda lambar waa inay buuxiyaan saddexdan unug si uun. Unuggu uma baahna inuu muujiyo dhammaan saddexda musharrax; waxa muhiimka ah waa in saddexda unug midkoodna uusan lahayn musharrax ka baxsan kooxdaas lambar.
Ka saar {digits} unug kasta oo kale oo kooxdan ({unit}) ah: {elim}.

mistakes: Qaadashada laba unug oo wadaaga laba musharrax laakiin sidoo kale leh mid saddexaad. Lammaane muuqda, unug kastaa waa inuu leeyahay labadaas musharrax oo keliya, waxba kale.
Lambarrada oo laga saaro unugyada lammaanaha laftooda. Lammaanuhu wuxuu haystaa musharraxiintiisa; saaridduhu waxay ku dhacaan unugyada kale ee kooxda.
In la shardiyo in unug kasta oo saddexda ah uu muujiyo dhammaan saddexda lambar. Unug leh laba ka mid ah saddexda waa caadi, inta aan unugna lahayn musharrax ka baxsan kooxdaas lambar.
faq: Waa maxay lammaane muuqda ee Sudoku?
Laba unug oo hal koox ku jira oo labaduba leeyihiin isla labada musharrax oo keliya. Labadaas lambar waxay ku xiran yihiin labadaas unug, markaa waa laga saari karaa inta ka hartay kooxda.
Waa maxay saddex muuqda?

Saddex unug oo hal koox ku jira oo musharraxiintoodu wadajir ay yihiin saddex lambar oo keliya. Unug kastaa wuxuu yeelan karaa laba ama saddex ka mid ah. Saddexda lambar waxay buuxiyaan saddexda unug, markaa waa laga saari karaa unugyada kale ee kooxda.
Lammaane muuqda ma dhigaa lambar?
Keligiis ma dhigo. Wuxuu saaraa musharraxiin, saariddaasina badanaa waxay ka tagtaa keli muuqda ama qarsoon. Tilmaanta Bare Sudoku waxay muujisaa keligaas waxayna magacawdaa farsamada suurtagelisay.
Lammaane muuqda ma ku jiri karaa sanduuq iyo saf isku mar?
Haa. Haddii labada unug ay wadaagaan saf iyo sanduuq, lammaanuhu wuxuu wax ka saaraa labada koox. Bare Sudoku wuxuu u maareeyaa hal koox mar kasta.

hidden-pairs.name: Laba iyo saddex qarsoon
hidden-pairs.title: Laba iyo saddex qarsoon ee Sudoku: sida loo helo
hidden-pairs.description: Lammaane qarsoon: laba lambar oo koox ku jira oo geli kara isla laba unug oo keliya; musharraxiintooda kale waa la saaraa. Baro sida loo helo tallaabo tallaabo.
hidden-pairs.h1: Laba iyo saddex qarsoon (hidden pairs)
hidden-pairs.summary: Lammaane qarsoon waa laba lambar oo, hal saf, tiir ama sanduuq dhexdiisa, musharrax ku ah isla laba unug oo aan meel kale ku jirin. Labadaas unug waa inay qaataan labadaas lambar, markaa musharrax kasta oo kale oo ku jira waa la saari karaa. Saddex qarsoon si la mid ah ayay u shaqaysaa iyadoo saddex lambar ay ku koobnaadaan saddex unug. Saaridda ka dib unugyadu waxay muujiyaan lammaane ama saddex muuqda. Tilmaanta Bare Sudoku waxay dhigista ka dhalata ku calaamadisaa "Laba ama saddex".
when: Marka koox ay leedahay unugyo leh musharraxiin badan, kelinimaduna ay dhammaatay. Lammaanayaasha qarsoon waxay ku dhuuntaan unugyo buuxa, waana sababta ay mudan tahay in lagu raadiyo meelaha aan lammaanayaasha muuqda laga arkin. Saddexda qarsoon waa dhif; Bare Sudoku wuu hubiyaa, laakiin halxiraalayaasha Adag badankood iyaga la'aan ayaa lagu xalliyaa.
spot: Ku shaqee lambar, ha ku shaqeyn unug. Koox dhexdeed, qor unugyada uu geli karo lambar kasta oo maqan. Haddii laba lambar mid kastaa uu leeyahay laba unug oo suurtagal ah oo keliya, oo ay yihiin isla labada unug, waxaad heshay lammaane qarsoon. Ciyaarta, taabo furaha lambar si aad u iftiimiso musharraxiintiisa; haddii laba lambar ay iftiimiyaan isla laba unug oo koox ah oo aan waxba kale oo kooxdaas ah iftiimin, taasi waa qaabka.

steps: Kooxda ({unit}) gudaheeda, lambarrada {d1} iyo {d2} mid kastaa wuxuu leeyahay laba unug oo suurtagal ah oo keliya, waana isla labada: {cells}.
Labadaas unug waa inay qaataan {d1} iyo {d2}, markaa musharraxiintooda kale waa wax aan suurtagal ahayn.
Ka saar {elim}. Hadda labada unug waxay muujinayaan lammaane muuqda, kaas oo furi kara wax kale.

mistakes: Labada lambar ee lammaanaha oo laga saaro unugyada lammaanaha. Waa musharraxiinta kale ee unugyadaas kuwa la saarayo; lambarrada lammaanahu way haraan.
Aqbalidda lambar leh unug saddexaad oo suurtagal ah oo kooxda ku jira. Labada lambar waa inay ku koobnaadaan labada unug oo keliya.
Raadinta sanduuqyada oo keliya. Lammaanayaasha qarsoon si la mid ah ayay ugu badan yihiin safafka iyo tiirarka.
faq: Waa maxay lammaane qarsoon ee Sudoku?
Laba lambar oo geli kara isla laba unug oo keliya oo koox ah. Unugyadaas waa inay qaataan lambarradaas, markaa musharraxiintooda kale waa la saaraa.
Sidee buu lammaane qarsoon uga duwan yahay lammaane muuqda?

Lammaane muuqda waa la arkaa: laba unug oo muujinaya isla labada musharrax oo keliya. Lammaane qarsoon waxaa daboolaya musharraxiin dheeraad ah oo ku jira labada unug. Marka la saaro kuwaas dheeraadka ah, lammaanaha qarsoon wuxuu noqdaa lammaane muuqda.
Waa maxay saddex qarsoon?

Saddex lambar oo ku koobnaaday saddex unug oo koox ah. Lambar kastaa uma baahna inuu ka muuqdo dhammaan saddexda unug; waxa muhiimka ah waa in saddexda lambar midkoodna uusan lahayn musharrax ka baxsan unugyadaas.
Tilmaantu ma kala saartaa lammaanayaasha qarsoon iyo kuwa muuqda?
Maya. Bare Sudoku wuxuu helaa labadaba wuxuuna dhigista ka dhalata ku calaamadiyaa "Laba ama saddex". Boggagan ayaa kala saara maxaa yeelay siyaabo kala duwan ayaa loo helaa.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing ee Sudoku: sida farsamadu u shaqeyso
x-wing.description: X-Wing: lambar leh laba unug oo musharrax ah oo keliya laba saf mid kasta, oo isla laba tiir ku jira, waxaa laga saaraa inta ka hartay tiirarkaas. Tusaale.
x-wing.summary: X-Wing waa qaab ka kooban hal lambar iyo afar unug oo ku yaal geesaha laydi. Haddii lambarku uu leeyahay laba unug oo musharrax ah oo keliya laba saf mid kasta, unugyadaasina ay ku jiraan isla laba tiir, lambarku waa inuu qabsadaa laba gees oo iska soo horjeeda oo laydiga ah. Sidaa darteed waa laga saari karaa unug kasta oo kale oo labadaas tiir ah. Isla sidaas ayay u shaqaysaa haddii safafka iyo tiirarka la isku beddelo. Waa farsamada ugu horreysa ee heerka Khabiir ee Bare Sudoku.
when: Marka kelinimada, musharraxiinta xiran iyo laba iyo saddexduba dhammaadaan. X-Wing waa qaabka Khabiir ee ugu badan, wuxuuna inta badan soo muuqdaa marka lambar uu leeyahay musharraxiin yar oo haray, caadiyan marka afar ilaa lix nuqul oo ka mid ah horeba la dhigay. Wuxuu u baahan yahay qoraallo dhammaystiran oo lambarka aad baarayso ah.
spot: Dooro lambar oo raadi safaf uu ku leeyahay laba unug oo musharrax ah oo keliya. Haddii laba saf oo caynkaas ah ay wadaagaan isla labada tiir, ka hubi tiirarkaas musharraxiin kale oo lambarkaas ah: kuwaasi waa saaridda. Kadib ku celi adoo tiirarka ka dhigaya saldhig. Ciyaarta, taabo furaha lambarka: musharrax kasta oo uu leeyahay waa la iftiiminayaa, laydi ka kooban afar qoraal oo iftiimayana si fudud ayaa loo arkaa.

steps: Lambarka {d} wuxuu leeyahay laba unug oo musharrax ah oo keliya safka {r1} iyo laba oo keliya safka {r2}, waxayna ku jiraan isla labada tiir, {c1} iyo {c2}: {cells}.
Safka {r1} wuxuu lambarkiisa {d} dhigaa tiirka {c1} ama {c2}, halka safka {r2} uu kiisa dhigo tiirka kale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tiirarka {c1} iyo {c2} mid kastaa wuxuu labadan saf ka helaa hal {d}.
Sidaa darteed {d} meel kale kama muuqan karo tiirarka {c1} iyo {c2}. Unugyada {elim} ka saar {d}.

mistakes: Isticmaalka saf lambarka u leh saddex unug oo musharrax ah. Saf kasta oo saldhig ah waa inuu leeyahay laba oo keliya, labaduba waa inay ku jiraan labada tiir ee la wadaago.
Lambarka oo laga saaro safafka halkii laga saari lahaa tiirarka. Marka safafku saldhig yihiin, saaridduhu waxay ku dhacaan tiirarka, lidkeeduna sidoo kale waa run.
Illaawidda nooca la rogay. X-Wing ku dhisan tiirar wuxuu wax ka saaraa safafka.
faq: Waa maxay X-Wing ee Sudoku?

Lambar leh laba unug oo musharrax ah oo keliya laba saf mid kasta, oo ku jira isla labada tiir. Lambarku wuxuu qabsadaa laba gees oo iska soo horjeeda oo laydigaas ah, markaa waxaa laga saaraa inta ka hartay labada tiir. Safafka iyo tiirarka waa la isku beddeli karaa.
Muxuu X-Wing u shaqeeyaa?

Labada saf mid kastaa waa inuu lambarka dhigaa mid ka mid ah labada tiir, labada safna ma isticmaali karaan isla tiirka. Sidaa darteed labada tiir mid kastaa wuxuu nuqulkiisa lambarka ka helaa safafkan, musharrax kasta oo kale oo tiirarkaas ku jirana waa wax aan suurtagal ahayn.
X-Wing ma kalluun baa?
Haa. X-Wing waa kalluunka cabbirkiisu yahay laba; Swordfish waa kalluunka cabbirkiisu yahay saddex. Bare Sudoku wuu helaa labadaba.
Heerkee ayaa leh X-Wing?
Khabiir. Halxiraale u baahan X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ama XYZ-Wing waxaa lagu qiimeeyaa Khabiir.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing ee Sudoku: sida farsamadu u shaqeyso
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): udub leh laba musharrax iyo laba baal oo mid kastaa la wadaago mid ka mid ah waxay lambar ka saaraan unug kasta oo arka labada baal. Tusaale.
y-wing.summary: Y-Wing, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan XY-Wing, wuxuu isticmaalaa saddex unug oo mid kastaa leeyahay laba musharrax. Udubku wuxuu leeyahay musharraxiinta X iyo Y. Hal baal ayaa arka udubka wuxuuna leeyahay X iyo Z; baalka kale wuxuu arkaa udubka wuxuuna leeyahay Y iyo Z. Udubku wuxuu doono ha noqdee, mid ka mid ah baalasha waa inuu noqdaa Z, markaa Z waa laga saari karaa unug kasta oo arka labada baal. Waa farsamo heerka Khabiir ah oo Bare Sudoku ku jirta.
when: Marka halxiraale uu leeyahay dhawr unug oo leh laba musharrax oo keliya, kalluunna aan la helin. Y-Wing wuxuu ku badan yahay halxiraalayaasha Khabiir, waxaana lagu helaa iyadoo la raacayo unugyada leh laba musharrax: mid kastaa wuxuu noqon karaa udub ama baal.
spot: Qor unugyada leh laba musharrax oo keliya. Mid kasta u qaado inuu yahay udubka oo leh musharraxiinta X iyo Y, kuna raadi derisyadiisa unug leh X iyo lambar kale oo Z ah, iyo unug leh Y iyo isla Z. Labadaasi waa baalasha. Kadib hel unugyada arka labada baal oo leh Z. Ogow in baalashu aysan u baahnayn inay is arkaan.

steps: Udubka {pivot} wuxuu leeyahay musharraxiinta {x} iyo {y}. Wuxuu arkaa {wingA}, oo leh {x} iyo {z}, iyo {wingB}, oo leh {y} iyo {z}.
Haddii {pivot} uu yahay {x}, {wingA} wuxuu lumiyaa {x} wuxuuna noqdaa {z}. Haddii {pivot} uu yahay {y}, {wingB} ayaa noqda {z}. Si kastaba ha ahaatee mid ka mid ah labada baal waa {z}.
Unug arka labada baal marnaba ma noqon karo {z}. Unugyada {elim} ka saar {z}.

mistakes: Doorashada baalal aan labaduba arkin udubka. Baal kastaa waa inuu udubka la wadaagaa saf, tiir ama sanduuq.
Z oo laga saaro unugyo arka hal baal oo keliya. Unugga laga saarayo waa inuu arkaa labada baal.
Z oo laga saaro udubka. Y-Wing gudihiisa udubku ma laha Z; haddii uu leeyahay, qaabku waa XYZ-Wing oo leh xeerar kale.
faq: Waa maxay Y-Wing ee Sudoku?

Saddex unug oo leh laba musharrax: udub leh X iyo Y, baal leh X iyo Z oo arka udubka, iyo baal leh Y iyo Z oo arka udubka. Hal baal had iyo jeer waa Z, markaa Z waxaa laga saaraa unugyada arka labada baal.
Y-Wing ma la mid baa XY-Wing?
Haa. Labada magac waxay sharxaan isla qaabka. Bare Sudoku wuxuu u yaqaan Y-Wing.
Maxay tahay in hal baal uu noqdo Z?
Haddii udubku yahay X, baalka koowaad wuxuu lumiyaa X wuxuuna noqdaa Z. Haddii udubku yahay Y, baalka labaad ayaa noqda Z. Udubku waa mid ka mid ah labadaas, markaa hal baal waa Z.
Immisa unug ayuu Y-Wing wax ka saaraa?
Badanaa hal ama laba: kaliya unugyada arka labada baal oo weli leh Z. Taasi way ku filan tahay in keli la abuuro.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish ee Sudoku: sida farsamadu u shaqeyso
swordfish.description: Swordfish: lambar ku koobnaaday saddex tiir oo saddex saf ah waa laga saaraa inta ka hartay tiirarkaas. Kalluun cabbirkiisu saddex yahay, tusaale lagu sharxay.
swordfish.summary: Swordfish waa X-Wing leh saddex saf iyo saddex tiir. Haddii lambar uu leeyahay ugu badnaan saddex unug oo musharrax ah saddex saf mid kasta, unugyadaas oo dhammina ay ku jiraan isla saddex tiir, saddexda saf waxay lambarka ku isticmaalaan tiirarkaas, lambarkana waa laga saari karaa unug kasta oo kale oo saddexda tiir ah. Safafka iyo tiirarka waa la isku beddeli karaa. Bare Sudoku wuxuu raadiyaa Swordfish Y-Wing ka dib, halxiraalayaasha Khabiir.
when: Marka X-Wing iyo Y-Wing aysan waxba helin. Swordfish wuu ka yar yahay X-Wing wuxuuna u baahan yahay lambar musharraxiintiisu si khafiif ah ugu kala firirsan yihiin saddex xariiq. Wuxuu u baahan yahay qoraallo dhammaystiran oo sax ah oo lambarkaas ah.
spot: Dooro lambar oo raadi safaf uu ku leeyahay laba ama saddex unug oo musharrax ah. Haddii saddex saf oo caynkaas ah ay wadajir u daboolaan saddex tiir oo keliya, ka hubi tiirarkaas musharraxiin kale oo lambarka ah. Saf kastaa uma baahna musharrax tiir kasta: Swordfish wuxuu yeelan karaa lix, toddoba, siddeed ama sagaal unug. Ciyaarta, lambarka ku iftiimi furihiisa oo raadi saddex saf oo musharraxiintoodu ku safan yihiin saddex tiir.

steps: Lambarka {d} wuxuu leeyahay ugu badnaan saddex unug oo musharrax ah safafka {rows} mid kasta, unugyadaas oo dhammina waxay ku jiraan tiirarka {cols}: {cells}.

Saddexda saf mid kastaa waa inuu lambarkiisa {d} dhigaa mid ka mid ah saddexda tiir, labo saf oo isla tiir isticmaalana ma jiraan. Sidaa darteed saddexda tiir waxay lambarkooda {d} ka helaan saddexdan saf.
Musharrax kasta oo kale oo {d} ah oo tiirarka {cols} ku jira waa wax aan suurtagal ahayn. Unugyada {elim} ka saar {d}.

mistakes: In la shardiyo dhammaan sagaalka unug. Swordfish leh laba musharrax safaf qaarkood weli waa sax, inta saddexda saf ay daboolaan saddex tiir oo keliya.
Ku darista saf leh afar unug oo musharrax ah. Saf kasta oo saldhig ah waa inuu leeyahay ugu badnaan saddex, dhammaantood saddexda tiir gudahooda.
Saaridda safafka saldhigga ah. Marka safafku saldhig yihiin, saaridduhu waxay ku dhacaan saddexda tiir, meel ka baxsan safafka saldhigga.
faq: Waa maxay Swordfish ee Sudoku?

Lambar musharraxiintiisa saddex saf ay ku koobnaadeen saddex tiir. Saddexda saf waa inay lambarka dhigaan saddexdaas tiir, tiir kasta mid, markaa lambarka waxaa laga saaraa unugyada kale ee tiirarkaas.
Sidee buu Swordfish uga duwan yahay X-Wing?
Cabbirka oo keliya: X-Wing wuxuu isticmaalaa laba saf iyo laba tiir, Swordfish saddex iyo saddex. Sababayntu waa isku mid.
Swordfish ma u baahan yahay sagaal unug oo dhammaystiran?
Maya. Saf kastaa wuxuu yeelan karaa laba ama saddex musharrax; qaabku wuxuu kaliya u baahan yahay in saddexda saf wadajir aysan isticmaalin wax ka badan saddex tiir.
Ma jiraa kalluun cabbirkiisu afar yahay?
Haa, Jellyfish. Bare Sudoku ma isticmaalo, maxaa yeelay halxiraalayaashiisu marnaba uma baahna.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing ee Sudoku: sida farsamadu u shaqeyso
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: udub leh saddex musharrax iyo laba baal oo wadaaga mid ka mid ah waxay lambarkaas ka saaraan unugyada arka saddexdaba. Tusaale, tallaabo tallaabo.
xyz-wing.summary: XYZ-Wing waa Y-Wing uu udubkiisu leeyahay saddex musharrax. Udubku wuxuu leeyahay X, Y iyo Z; hal baal ayaa arka udubka wuxuuna leeyahay X iyo Z, kan kalena wuxuu arkaa udubka wuxuuna leeyahay Y iyo Z. Saddexda unug mid ka mid ah waa inuu noqdaa Z, markaa Z waa laga saari karaa unug kasta oo arka saddexdaba. Maadaama udubka laftiisu uu noqon karo Z, unugga laga saarayo waa inuu arkaa udubka iyo labada baalba, taasoo ku koobaysa sanduuqa ama xariiqda ay unugyadu wadaagaan. Waa farsamada ugu adag ee Bare Sudoku isticmaalo.
when: Kaliya marka wax kasta oo kale ay fashilmaan. XYZ-Wing waa qaabka ugu dhifka badan Bare Sudoku, wuxuuna ka muuqdaa halxiraalayaasha Khabiir oo keliya. Raadi marka unug leh saddex musharrax uu sanduuq kula jiro unug leh laba musharrax oo la wadaaga laba ka mid ah lambarradiisa.
spot: Ka bilow unugyada leh saddex musharrax oo keliya; mid kastaa wuxuu noqon karaa udub. Derisyadiisa ka raadi laba unug oo mid kastaa leeyahay laba musharrax, labaduba laga soo qaaday saddexda udubka, oo wadaaga hal lambar oo keliya oo Z ah. Kadib raadi unugyo arka udubka iyo labada baal oo leh Z. Dhab ahaan hal baal wuxuu ku jiraa sanduuqa udubka, kan kalena safkiisa ama tiirkiisa, unugyada laga saarayona waa unugyada ka haray sanduuqaas ee ku jira safkaas ama tiirkaas.

steps: Udubka {pivot} wuxuu leeyahay saddex musharrax: {x}, {y} iyo {z}. Wuxuu arkaa {wingA} oo leh {x} iyo {z}, iyo {wingB} oo leh {y} iyo {z}.

Haddii {pivot} uu yahay {z}, waa dhammaatay. Haddii uu yahay {x}, {wingA} waa inuu noqdaa {z}. Haddii uu yahay {y}, {wingB} waa inuu noqdaa {z}. Si kastaba ha ahaatee saddexda unug mid ka mid ah waa {z}.
Unug arka saddexdaba ma noqon karo {z}. Unugyada {elim} ka saar {z}.

mistakes: Ka saarid unugyo arka labada baal oo keliya. Si ka duwan Y-Wing, udubku wuxuu noqon karaa Z, markaa unuggu waa inuu sidoo kale arkaa udubka.
Isticmaalka baalal aan musharraxiintoodu labaduba ku jirin saddexda musharrax ee udubka.
Lagu qaldo Y-Wing: farqigu waa musharraxa saddexaad ee udubka, wuxuuna beddelaa unugyada la nadiifin karo.
faq: Waa maxay XYZ-Wing ee Sudoku?

Udub leh musharraxiinta X, Y iyo Z iyo laba baal, mid leh X iyo Z iyo mid leh Y iyo Z, oo labaduba arkaan udubka. Saddexda unug mid ka mid ah waa Z, markaa Z waxaa laga saaraa unugyada arka saddexdaba.
Sidee buu XYZ-Wing uga duwan yahay Y-Wing?

Udubku wuxuu leeyahay saddex musharrax halkii uu laba ka lahaan lahaa, oo uu Z ku jiro. Taasi waxay udubka ka dhigaysaa meel Z geli karo, markaa kaliya unugyada arka udubka iyo labada baal ayaa lumin kara Z.
Intee jeer ayuu XYZ-Wing soo muuqdaa?
Dhif. Bare Sudoku gudihiisa, halxiraalayaasha Khabiir oo keliya ayaa u baahan kara, badankoodna uma baahna. Bare Sudoku wuxuu hubiyaa ugu dambeyn, X-Wing, Y-Wing iyo Swordfish ka dib.
Ma jiraa WXYZ-Wing?
Haa, oo leh udub afar musharrax leh, laakiin Bare Sudoku ma isticmaalo. Halxiraale kasta oo ciyaarta ku jira waxaa lagu dhammayn karaa sagaalka farsamo ee hagahan.

xh.learnText: Umtsha kwi-Sudoku, okanye ubambekile kwimfumba enzima? Izikhokelo ezimbini zichaza imithetho nendlela nganye yokusombulula esetyenziswa ngamacebiso, zombini zinemizekelo yokwenyani.

labels.legend: Amanani angqindilili anikiwe, amanani aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka afakwe ngexesha lokusombulula, amanani amancinci ngabangeneli. Iiseli ezikhanyisiweyo zenza ipateni, abangeneli abacinyiweyo bayasuswa, kwaye umngeneli ojikelezwe ngesangqa linani ekufuneka lifakwe.
labels.notation: Iiseli zibhalwa ngolu hlobo: r3c7, oko kukuthi umgca 3, ikholam 7. Imigca ibalwa ukusuka phezulu, iikholam ukusuka ngasekhohlo, kwaye iibhokisi zibalwa ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-9 ukusuka phezulu ekhohlo, umgca ngomgca.
labels.regions: Umgca 5, ikholam 5 nebhokisi 5 ekuqaleni kwemfumba
labels.firstMove: Eyodwa ecacileyo: iseli {cell} inokuba yi-{d} kuphela

howTo.title: Idlalwa njani i-Sudoku: imithetho, igridi, ukuqala
howTo.description: Funda ukudlala i-Sudoku: imithetho, imigca, iikholam neebhokisi, isizathu sokuba imfumba nganye inesisombululo esinye, amanqaku namanyathelo okuqala.
howTo.summary: I-Sudoku yimfumba yengqiqo kwigridi engu-9×9. Zalisa iseli nganye engenanto ngenani ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-9 ukuze inani ngalinye libe kanye kuphela kumgca ngamnye, kwikholam nganye nakwibhokisi nganye engu-3×3. Amanye amanani anikwa ekuqaleni; amanye uwafumana ngengqiqo, iseli eqinisekileyo enye emva kwenye, kwaye akunyanzelekanga ukuba uqikelele. Esi sikhokelo sichaza igridi, imithetho, umgaqo wesisombululo esinye, amanqaku kunye nesicwangciso esilula samanyathelo akho okuqala. Ungaziqhelisela zonke ezi zinto kwi-[Bare Sudoku](play), esimahla kwaye enamacebiso achaza ingqiqo.

p: Mithathu kuphela imithetho, kwaye ingumthetho omnye obonwa ngamacala amathathu: umgca ngamnye kufuneka ube namanani u-1 ukuya ku-9, ikholam nganye kufuneka ibe namanani u-1 ukuya ku-9, kwaye ibhokisi nganye engu-3×3 kufuneka ibe namanani u-1 ukuya ku-9. Ngoko inani alinakuze libonakale kabini kumgca omnye, kwikholam enye okanye kwibhokisi enye.

Amanani anikiweyo, ashicilelwe engqindilili, akatshintshi. Umsebenzi wakho kukuzalisa iiseli ezingenanto. Akukho zibalo kwaye akukho kulandelelana: amanani ziimpawu ezilithoba nje ezahlukeneyo. Ungadlala ngoonobumba okanye ngeemilo kwaye akukho nto ibiya kutshintsha.

Igridi ineeseli ezingama-81 kwimigca elithoba nakwiikholam ezilithoba. Imida engqindilili iyahlula ibe ziibhokisi ezilithoba ezingu-3×3. Iseli nganye ikumgca omnye, kwikholam enye nakwibhokisi enye kuphela, kwaye la maqela mathathu ziiyunithi zayo. Ezinye iiseli ezingama-20 ezabelana ngeyunithi neseli zibizwa ngokuba ngabamelwane bayo; inani elifakwe kwiseli likhupha elo nani kubo bonke abamelwane abangama-20.

Iiseli zibhalwa ngolu hlobo: r3c7, oko kukuthi umgca 3, ikholam 7. Imigca ibalwa ukusuka phezulu, iikholam ukusuka ngasekhohlo, kwaye iibhokisi zibalwa ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-9 ukusuka phezulu ekhohlo, umgca ngomgca. Olu phawu lusetyenziswa kuso sonke isikhokelo sendlela kwaye kufanelekile ukulufunda: i-r5c5 isembindini wegridi.

sections.h: Kutheni i-Sudoku nganye inesisombululo esinye kuphela?
p: I-Sudoku eyiyo inesisombululo esinye, kwaye yiloo nto eyenza ingqiqo isebenze. Nanini na xa unokubonisa ukuba inani alinakuya naphi na kwenye indawo kwiyunithi, kufuneka liye kwiseli eseleyo, kuba isisombululo sikhona kwaye sisinye kuphela. Ukuba imfumba ibinezisombululo ezibini, akukho kuqiqa bekunokuzahlula, kwaye ngaxa lithile ubuya kunyanzeleka ukuba uqikelele.

I-Bare Sudoku yenza imfumba nganye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye ijonga ukuba inesisombululo esinye kuphela nokuba isisombululi sayo sengqiqo singayigqiba ngeendlela zenqanaba olikhethileyo. Ngoko ukuba ubambekile, kusoloko kukho inyathelo elilandelayo ekufuneka lifunyanwe, kwaye icebiso liyalibonisa.
Qala ngezona ndawo zithintelwe kakhulu. Olu landelelwano lusebenza kuwo onke amanqanaba:
list: Khetha inani esele libonakala amaxesha amaninzi, masithi kathandathu okanye kasixhenxe, uze ufumane iibhokisi ezingekabinalo. Kaninzi kusala iseli enye kuphela kwibhokisi apho linokungena khona: nantsi [eyodwa efihlakeleyo](hidden-single).

Khangela iiseli ezijikelezwe ngamanani amaninzi. Iseli apho umgca wayo, ikholam yayo nebhokisi yayo zizonke zinamanani asibhozo ahlukeneyo inomngeneli omnye kuphela oseleyo: nantsi [eyodwa ecacileyo](naked-single). Iiseli ezikwimigca okanye kwiibhokisi eziphantse ukuzala zezona ndawo zilungileyo zokukhangela.
Inani ngalinye olifakayo lisusa umngeneli kubamelwane abangama-20, ngoko jonga abo bamelwane ngoko nangoko. Ezizodwa zihlala zisiza ngokulandelelana.

Xa ukufaka okulula kuphelile, bhala amanqaku: abangeneli beseli nganye engenanto. Emva koko khangela inani elivalelwe kumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye ngaphakathi kwebhokisi ([abangeneli abatshixiweyo](locked-candidates)) okanye iiseli ezimbini ezinabangeneli ababini abafanayo ([isibini esicacileyo](naked-pairs)).
Buyela kwezizodwa emva kokususa ngakunye. Kwaneemfumba zeNgcali zisonjululwa ikakhulu ngezizodwa; indlela ephambili ivula nje inyathelo elilandelayo.

p: Amanqaku, akwabizwa ngokuba ngamanqaku epensile okanye abangeneli, ngamanani amancinci owabhala kwiseli engenanto ukuze ubone ukuba ngawaphi amanani asenokungena apho. Kwiimfumba ezilula akufane uwadinge; ukusukela kwinqanaba elithi Kunzima ayafuneka kakhulu, kuba iindlela ezinjengezibini, i-X-Wing ne-Y-Wing zijongana nabangeneli, hayi namanani afakiweyo.

Gcina amanqaku echanekile: xa ufaka inani, lisuse kumanqaku abo bonke abamelwane abangama-20. Kwi-Bare Sudoku oku kwenzeka ngokuzenzekelayo, kwaye iqhosha elithi Zalisa amanqaku libhala wonke umngeneli kuyo yonke iseli engenanto ngokucofa kanye, ukuze uqale ngeqela labangeneli elipheleleyo nelichanekileyo. Inqaku liyinyani, alikokuqikelela: lithetha ukuba akukho nto ilikhuphayo eli nani okwangoku.

Kuqala phinda ujonge izinto ezisisiseko: wonke umgca, ikholam nebhokisi ephantse ukuzala ngumthombo wezizodwa. Emva koko qinisekisa ukuba amanqaku apheleleyo, kuba umngeneli ongekhoyo ufihla iipateni kwaye umngeneli ongasasebenziyo wenza iipateni zobuxoki. Emva koko landela [iindlela](techniques) ngokobunzima bazo: abangeneli abatshixiweyo, izibini nezithathu, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish ne-XYZ-Wing. Nganye inephepha layo elinomzekelo wokwenyani.

Ukuba akukho nto isebenzayo, thatha icebiso. Kwi-Bare Sudoku icebiso liqala lijonge ukuba kukho inani elifakiweyo elingalunganga na, emva koko lifumane iseli elandelayo enokuzaliswa ngengqiqo kwaye libize igama lendlela, ngoko ufunda into nokuba uyalisebenzisa. Cofa icebiso kwakhona ukuze ufake inani.

Cofa iseli, uze ucofe inani. Okanye cofa inani kuqala: liyatshixeka, kwaye iseli nganye oyicofayo iyalifumana; le yeyona ndlela ikhawulezayo yokufaka ikopi yesithandathu, yesixhenxe neyesibhozo yenani. Cofa inani kwakhona ukuze ulivule. Iqhosha elithi Amanqaku litshintshela kumanqaku epensile, Cima icima iseli, Buyisela ibuyisa nayiphi na intshukumo, kwaye iimpazamo ziphawulwa ngombala obomvu ngaphandle kokuba ukucime oko kwimenyu.

Kwikhibhodi, sebenzisa amaqhosha otolo ukuhamba, u-1 ukuya ku-9 ukufaka inani, Backspace ukucima, N yamanqaku, U yokubuyisela, H yecebiso, F yokuzalisa amanqaku kunye ne-Escape yemenyu. Umdlalo uzigcina ngokwawo, usebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kwaye awunazo iintengiso okanye iakhawunti.

faq: Ingaba kukho xa kufuneka uqikelele kwi-Sudoku?

Hayi kwimfumba eyiyo. Yonke imfumba ye-Bare Sudoku inesisombululo esinye kuphela kwaye ijongiwe ukuba ingasonjululwa ngengqiqo kuphela, kude kube ziindlela zenqanaba layo. Ukuba uziva ngathi kufuneka uqikelele, kukho umngeneli ongekhoyo kumanqaku akho okanye kukho indlela elindele ukufunyanwa.
Ingaba inani linokubonakala kabini kumgca, kwikholam okanye kwibhokisi?

Hayi. Nguwo lowo umthetho uphela: kwimigca elithoba, kwiikholam ezilithoba nakwiibhokisi ezilithoba, nganye inenani ngalinye ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-9 kube kanye kuphela. Ukuba amanani amabini afanayo akwiyunithi enye, ubuncinci elinye lawo aliyilo.
Yintoni umahluko phakathi kwamanqanaba athi Kulula, Phakathi, Kunzima nelithi Ingcali?

Inqanaba limiselwa ziindlela ezifunwa yimfumba. Iimfumba ezilula neziphakathi zisonjululwa ngezizodwa kuphela, kwaye iimfumba ezilula ziqala ubuncinci ngamanani anikiweyo angama-38. Inqanaba elithi Kunzima lifuna abangeneli abatshixiweyo okanye izibini nezithathu. Inqanaba elithi Ingcali lifuna i-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing, i-Swordfish okanye i-XYZ-Wing.
Ingaba kungcono ukuzalisa amanqaku kuzo zonke iiseli okanye kwezinye kuphela?

Kwiimfumba ezinzima nezeNgcali, zalisa onke: iipateni ezinjengezibini, i-X-Wing ne-Y-Wing zibonakala kuphela xa wonke umngeneli ebhaliwe. Kwiimfumba ezilula neziphakathi amanqaku akanyanzelekanga, kwaye uninzi lwabadlali lukhangela ezizodwa kuphela.
Ithatha ixesha elingakanani i-Sudoku?

Imfumba elula ithatha imizuzu embalwa; iimfumba zeNgcali zinokuthatha imizuzu engamashumi amabini nangaphezulu, kuxhomekeke ekukhawuleni kwakho ukubona ipateni ephambili. I-Bare Sudoku ibonisa isibali-xesha, isimisa xa imenyu ivulekile kwaye ayigcini luhlu lwabaphumeleleyo, ngoko dlala ngesantya sakho.
Ingaba i-Sudoku ifuna izibalo?
Hayi. Amanani ziilebheli nje; akukho kudibanisa okanye kubala. Naziphi na iimpawu ezilithoba bezinokusebenza, kwaye yiyo loo nto i-Sudoku iyimfumba yengqiqo, hayi imfumba yamanani.

index.title: Iindlela zokusombulula i-Sudoku zichazwe ngemizekelo
index.description: Zonke iindlela ezilithoba zokusombulula i-Sudoku, ukusuka kwezizodwa ezicacileyo ukuya kwi-Swordfish ne-XYZ-Wing, ngokulandelelana kwamacebiso e-Bare Sudoku.
intro: Yonke i-Sudoku ingasonjululwa ngeqela elincinci leendlela zengqiqo. Olu luhlu lubonisa iindlela ezilithoba ezisetyenziswa sisisombululi se-Bare Sudoku namacebiso aso, ngokulandelelana esizizama ngako: ezizodwa kuqala, emva koko ukususa ngaphakathi kweyunithi enye, emva koko iipateni ezinabela kwimigca neekholam ezininzi. Indlela nganye inephepha layo elinenkcazelo, indlela yokuyibona, umzekelo wokwenyani ovela kwimfumba eyenziweyo kunye neempazamo eziqhelekileyo.

Inqanaba lemfumba ligqitywa yeyona ndlela inzima eyifunayo. Iimfumba ezilula neziphakathi zifuna ezizodwa kuphela, iimfumba ezinzima zifuna abangeneli abatshixiweyo okanye izibini nezithathu, kwaye iimfumba zeNgcali zifuna ubuncinci intlanzi enye okanye iphiko elinye. Nokuba lithini na inqanaba, ezizodwa zenza uninzi lomsebenzi; indlela ephambili isusa umngeneli omnye okanye ababini, kwaye ezizodwa ziqhubeka ukusuka apho.
faq: Ndizame iindlela ze-Sudoku ngoluphi ulandelelwano?

Ezona zilula kuqala: ezizodwa ezicacileyo, ezizodwa ezifihlakeleyo, abangeneli abatshixiweyo, izibini nezithathu ezicacileyo, izibini nezithathu ezifihlakeleyo, X-Wing, Y-Wing, Swordfish, XYZ-Wing. I-Bare Sudoku izizama ngolu landelelwano kanye, kwaye icebiso lihlala libiza eyona ndlela ilula eqhubela phambili.
Ingaba ndizidinga zonke ezi ndlela ukuze ndisombulule i-Sudoku?

Kwiimfumba ezilula neziphakathi, ezizodwa zanele. Iimfumba ezinzima zongeza abangeneli abatshixiweyo nezibini nezithathu. Iimfumba zeNgcali zifuna ubuncinci intlanzi enye okanye iphiko elinye, kodwa ngokuqhelekileyo kube kanye okanye kabini kuphela kwimfumba nganye.
Ingaba zikhona iindlela ezinzima ngakumbi kune-XYZ-Wing?

Ewe, umzekelo amatyathanga, iimvavanyo zokuba isisombululo sisinye neminatha enyanzelayo. I-Bare Sudoku ayenzi iimfumba ezizifunayo, ngoko yonke imfumba emdlalweni ingagqitywa ngeendlela ezilithoba ezikweli phepha.
Yintoni umngeneli?

Linani elisenokungena kwiseli engenanto kuba akukho nto kumgca wayo, kwikholam yayo okanye kwibhokisi yayo elikhuphayo okwangoku. Amanqaku emdlalweni ngabangeneli. Yonke indlela engaphaya kwezizodwa iqiqa ngabangeneli, ngoko bagcine bepheleleyo kwaye bechanekile.

naked-single.name: Eyodwa ecacileyo
naked-single.title: Eyodwa ecacileyo kwi-Sudoku: iseli enomngeneli omnye
naked-single.description: Eyodwa ecacileyo yiseli engenanto enenani elinye kuphela elinokungena. Funda ukuzifumana ngokukhawuleza, ngomzekelo wokwenyani neempazamo eziqhelekileyo.
naked-single.summary: Eyodwa ecacileyo yiseli engenanto enomngeneli omnye kuphela: amanye amanani asibhozo sele ebonakala kumgca wayo, kwikholam yayo okanye kwibhokisi yayo. Inani eliseleyo kufuneka lingene apho. Yeyona ndlela ilula ye-Sudoku, leyo uyisebenzisa rhoqo, kwaye yileyo icebiso le-Bare Sudoku liyibika ngamazwi athi "Mnye kuphela ongenela apha".
when: Rhoqo. Ezizodwa ezicacileyo zibonakala ukusuka kwinyathelo lokuqala ukuya kwelokugqibela, kuwo onke amanqanaba. Kwiimfumba ezilula neziphakathi, kunye nezizodwa ezifihlakeleyo, kuphela kwendlela oyidingayo. Kwiimfumba ezinzima ngakumbi, ukususa ngakunye okwenziwa yindlela ephambili kudla ngokushiya eyodwa ecacileyo, ngoko zikhangele emva kwenyathelo ngalinye.
spot: Jonga iiseli ezinabamelwane abaninzi abasele bezalisiwe: iseli ekumgca osele unamanani asixhenxe, okanye iseli apho umgca wayo, ikholam yayo nebhokisi yayo zizonke zigubungela amanani asibhozo ahlukeneyo. Ngaphandle kwamanqaku, bala amanani onokuwabona ukusuka kwiseli. Ngamanqaku, eyodwa ecacileyo yiseli ebonisa umngeneli omnye nje, yiyo loo nto iqhosha elithi Zalisa amanqaku lizenza zibe lula ukufumaneka.

steps: Jonga iseli {cell}. Ayinanto, ngoko bhala uluhlu lwawo onke amanani asele efakiwe kumgca wayo, kwikholam yayo nakwibhokisi yayo.
Umgca {row} unamanani {rowDigits}. Ikholam {col} inamanani {colDigits}. Ibhokisi {box} inamanani {boxDigits}.
Xa edibene, akhupha onke amanani ngaphandle kwe-{d}, ngoko i-{d} ngumngeneli ekuphela kwakhe oseleyo kwiseli {cell}.
Bhala i-{d} kwiseli {cell}. Emva koko jonga ukuba inani elitsha lenza enye eyodwa kumgca lowo, kwikholam leyo okanye kwibhokisi leyo.

mistakes: Ukubala umgca kuphela okanye ibhokisi kuphela. Amanani asibhozo akhutshiweyo adla ngokuvela kuzo zontathu iiyunithi zizonke.
Ukulibala ukuba inani osandula ukulifaka likhupha abangeneli nakubamelwane balo abangama-20; ezizodwa ezicacileyo ezintsha zibonakala kwangoko emva kokufaka ngakunye.
Ukudida eyodwa ecacileyo neyodwa efihlakeleyo: eyodwa ecacileyo inomngeneli omnye oseleyo kwiseli, eyodwa efihlakeleyo inendawo enye eseleyo yenani kwiyunithi.
faq: Yintoni eyodwa ecacileyo kwi-Sudoku?
Yiseli engenanto enomngeneli omnye kuphela. Amanani asibhozo ahlukeneyo sele efakiwe kumgca wayo, kwikholam yayo nakwibhokisi yayo, ngoko inani lesithoba kuphela kwalo elilungelayo.
Kutheni ibizwa ngokuba ecacileyo?
Kuba umngeneli omnye ubonakala ngqo kwiseli xa amanqaku ebhaliwe; akukho nto imfihlayo. Eyodwa efihlakeleyo yona ihleli phakathi kwabanye abangeneli kwaye ifunyanwa ngokujonga inani endaweni yeseli.
Ingaba imfumba ingasonjululwa ngezizodwa ezicacileyo kuphela?

Iimfumba ezininzi ezilula zingasonjululwa, kodwa uninzi lwazo lufuna nezizodwa ezifihlakeleyo. I-Bare Sudoku ibeka iimfumba ezilula neziphakathi njengezisonjululwa ngezizodwa zazo zombini iintlobo; iimfumba ezinzima nezeNgcali zifuna ubuncinci enye indlela.
Ingaba icebiso libonisa ezizodwa ezicacileyo?
Ewe. Xa ukufaka okulandelayo kuyeyodwa ecacileyo, icebiso likhetha iseli kwaye lithi "Mnye kuphela ongenela apha" kunye nenani. Cofa icebiso kwakhona ukuze ulifake.

hidden-single.name: Eyodwa efihlakeleyo
hidden-single.title: Eyodwa efihlakeleyo kwi-Sudoku: indawo enye yenani
hidden-single.description: Eyodwa efihlakeleyo yiseli ekuphela kwayo kumgca, kwikholam okanye kwibhokisi apho inani lisenokungena. Funda ukuzibona ngokuhlola inani elinye ngexesha.
hidden-single.summary: Eyodwa efihlakeleyo linani elinendawo enye kuphela eseleyo kumgca, kwikholam okanye kwibhokisi, nokuba iseli leyo ibonisa abanye abangeneli. Ekubeni iyunithi kufuneka ibe nelo nani, lingena apho. Icebiso le-Bare Sudoku liyibika ngamazwi athi "Yindawo enye kuphela ye-5 kulo mgca", ikholam okanye ibhokisi.
when: Nanini na xa inani lihambele phambili: xa inani sele libonakala kahlanu okanye kathandathu, iibhokisi eziseleyo zithintelwe kakhulu, kwaye eyodwa efihlakeleyo idla ngokuba linyathelo elilandelayo. Ezizodwa ezifihlakeleyo yeyona ndlela iphambili yeemfumba ezilula neziphakathi kwaye zihlala ziyinkabi yomsebenzi kuwo onke amanqanaba.
spot: Hlola inani elinye ngexesha. Thatha inani, fumana ibhokisi engenalo, uze ucime yonke iseli yaloo bhokisi ekumgca okanye kwikholam enye nekopi yenani esele ifakiwe. Ukuba kusala iseli enye, ufumene eyodwa efihlakeleyo. Oku kuhlola kusebenza nakwimigca nakwiikholam. Emdlalweni, cofa inani elifakiweyo: zonke iikopi zalo ziyakhanyiswa, ngoko iiseli ezingenanto ziyabonakala.

steps: Ibhokisi {box} ayikabi nayo i-{d}, ngoko enye yeeseli zayo ezingenanto kufuneka ibe nayo. Iiseli ezingenanto zezi: {empties}.
Kuzo zonke ngaphandle kweseli {cell}, i-{d} ivalwa yi-{d} esele ifakiwe kumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye nazo, ngoko i-{d} ayingomngeneli apho.
Oko kushiya iseli {cell} njengendawo ekuphela kwayo ye-{d} kwibhokisi {box}. Bhala i-{d} apho, nokuba iseli {cell} isenokubonisa abanye abangeneli.

mistakes: Ukufaka inani kwiseli ebonakala ngathi iyiyo nje: jonga yonke enye iseli engenanto yeyunithi, hayi ezicacileyo kuphela.
Ukuphosa eyodwa efihlakeleyo kuba iseli ibonisa abangeneli abaninzi. Abanye abangeneli abanamsebenzi; okubalulekileyo kukuba inani alinayo enye indawo kwiyunithi.
Ukuhlola iibhokisi kuphela. Imigca neekholam zivelisa ezizodwa ezifihlakeleyo rhoqo ngokulinganayo, ingakumbi ngasekupheleni.
faq: Yintoni eyodwa efihlakeleyo kwi-Sudoku?
Linani elinokungena kwiseli enye kuphela yomgca, yekholam okanye yebhokisi. Iyunithi kufuneka ibe nelo nani, ngoko iseli igqitywe, nokuba isenabo abanye abangeneli.
Yintoni umahluko phakathi kweyodwa efihlakeleyo neyodwa ecacileyo?
Eyodwa ecacileyo imalunga neseli: kusala umngeneli omnye. Eyodwa efihlakeleyo imalunga nenani: kusala iseli enye kwiyunithi. Zombini zifaka inani ngokuqiniseka.
Yeyiphi elula ukuyifumana?

Ngaphandle kwamanqaku, ezizodwa ezifihlakeleyo zidla ngokuba lula kuba unokuhlola igridi inani elinye ngexesha. Ngamanqaku apheleleyo, ezizodwa ezicacileyo zezona zilula, kuba iseli enomngeneli omnye iyabonakala.
Icebiso liyichaza njani eyodwa efihlakeleyo?
Ngamazwi athi "Yindawo enye kuphela ye-" nenani kulo mgca, kule kholam okanye kule bhokisi, iseli ikhethiwe. Cofa icebiso kwakhona ukuze ulifake.

locked-candidates.name: Abangeneli abatshixiweyo
locked-candidates.title: Abangeneli abatshixiweyo kwi-Sudoku: ukukhomba nokubanga
locked-candidates.description: Abangeneli abatshixiweyo: xa bonke abangeneli benani kwibhokisi bekumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye, okanye ngokuchaseneyo, inani lisuswa kwezinye iindawo.
locked-candidates.summary: Abangeneli abatshixiweyo yindlela yokuqala esusa abangeneli endaweni yokufaka inani. Inezimo ezibini. Ukukhomba: kwibhokisi, bonke abangeneli benani bakumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye, ngoko inani lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zaloo mgca okanye ikholam. Ukubanga: kumgca okanye kwikholam, bonke abangeneli benani bakwibhokisi enye, ngoko inani lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zaloo bhokisi. Icebiso le-Bare Sudoku liphawula ukufaka elikuvulayo ngamazwi athi "Abangeneli abatshixiweyo".
when: Xa ezizodwa ziphela kwimfumba enzima, le yeyona nto yokuqala ukuyizama. Ifuna amanqaku apheleleyo ubuncinci kwinani olihlolayo. Abangeneli abatshixiweyo baqhelekile: uninzi lweemfumba ezinzima luyabafuna, kwaye iimfumba zeNgcali zibasebenzisa phakathi kweepateni ezinkulu.
spot: Ukukhomba, jonga ibhokisi nganye nenani ngalinye elingekhoyo kuyo: ukuba iiseli ezinomngeneli welo nani zikumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye, jonga ukuba inani elifanayo livela njengomngeneli kwaloo mgca okanye ikholam ngaphandle kwebhokisi. Ukubanga, jonga ecaleni komgca okanye ikholam: ukuba bonke abangeneli benani bangaphakathi kwebhokisi enye, ezinye iiseli zaloo bhokisi zingacocwa. Emdlalweni, cofa iqhosha lenani ukuze ukhanyise bonke abangeneli balo; umgca wamanqaku amabini okanye amathathu akhanyisiweyo ngaphakathi kwebhokisi enye yipateni.

steps: Kwibhokisi {box}, inani {d} lingangena kuphela kwezi seli: {cells}. Zonke zikumgca {row}.
Ibhokisi {box} idinga i-{d}, ngoko i-{d} yomgca {row} ingaphakathi kwebhokisi {box}, nokuba iwela kweyiphi na kwezo seli.
Umgca {row} awunakuba ne-{d} yesibini, ngoko susa i-{d} kwiiseli zomgca {row} ezingaphandle kwebhokisi: {elim}.
Kumgca {row}, inani {d} lingangena kuphela kwiiseli {cells}, kwaye zonke zingaphakathi kwebhokisi {box}.
Umgca {row} kufuneka ube ne-{d}, ngoko i-{d} yebhokisi {box} ibangwa ngumgca {row}. Ezinye iiseli zebhokisi {box} azinakuba ne-{d}.
Susa i-{d} kwiiseli {elim}.

mistakes: Ukususa inani ngaphakathi kwebhokisi endaweni yangaphandle kwayo kwimeko yokukhomba, okanye ngokuchaseneyo kwimeko yokubanga. Ukususwa kuhlala kusiya kwiiseli ezikumgca okanye kwikholam kodwa zingekho kwibhokisi, okanye ezikwibhokisi kodwa zingekho kumgca okanye kwikholam.
Ukusebenzisa umthetho xa abangeneli benabela kwimigca emibini yebhokisi. Zonke iiseli ezinomngeneli welo nani kwibhokisi kufuneka zibe kumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye.
Ukulibala ukukhangela eyodwa eyenziwa kukususa. Abangeneli abatshixiweyo kunqabile ukuba bafake inani ngokwabo; balungiselela eyodwa.
faq: Yintoni abangeneli abatshixiweyo kwi-Sudoku?

Ngabangeneli benani abavalelwe kwindawo edibana kuyo ibhokisi nomgca okanye ikholam. Ekubeni ibhokisi, okanye umgca, kufuneka ibe nelo nani ngaphakathi kwaloo ndawo idibanayo, inani lingasuswa kwezinye iiseli zomgca, okanye kwezinye iiseli zebhokisi.
Yintoni umahluko phakathi kokukhomba nokubanga?

Ukukhomba kuqala kwibhokisi: abangeneli benani kwibhokisi bakhomba kumgca omnye okanye kwikholam enye, ngoko inani lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zaloo mgca okanye ikholam. Ukubanga kuqala kumgca okanye kwikholam: bonke abangeneli balo benani bakwibhokisi enye, ngoko umgca uyalibanga inani, kwaye lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zebhokisi.
Ingaba abangeneli abatshixiweyo bakwabizwa ngokuba kukususwa kwindawo edibanayo?
Ewe. Amanye amagama kukuncitshiswa kwebhokisi nomgca kwimo yokubanga, nezibini ezikhombayo okanye izithathu ezikhombayo kwimo yokukhomba. I-Bare Sudoku isebenzisa igama elinye kuzo zombini.
Leliphi inqanaba elifuna abangeneli abatshixiweyo?
Kunzima. Imfumba efuna abangeneli abatshixiweyo okanye izibini nezithathu, kodwa ingafuni nto inzima ngakumbi, ibekwa kwinqanaba elithi Kunzima; iimfumba zeNgcali zifuna nentlanzi okanye iphiko.

naked-pairs.name: Izibini nezithathu ezicacileyo
naked-pairs.title: Izibini nezithathu ezicacileyo kwi-Sudoku: zisebenza njani
naked-pairs.description: Izibini nezithathu ezicacileyo: iiseli ezimbini okanye ezintathu kwiyunithi ezinabangeneli abafanayo. Funda ukuzibona nento ekufuneka isuswe, ngemizekelo.
naked-pairs.h1: Izibini nezithathu ezicacileyo (naked pairs, naked triples)
naked-pairs.summary: Isibini esicacileyo ziiseli ezimbini kumgca omnye, kwikholam enye okanye kwibhokisi enye ezinabangeneli ababini abafanayo ngqo. La manani mabini kufuneka angene kwezo seli zimbini, ngoko angasuswa kuyo yonke enye iseli yeyunithi. Isithathu esicacileyo sisimbo esifanayo neeseli ezintathu namanani amathathu; iseli nganye ingabonisa amabini okanye omathathu. Icebiso le-Bare Sudoku liphawula ukufaka okulandelayo ngamazwi athi "Isibini okanye isithathu".
when: Emva kokuba amanqaku epheleleyo kwaye ezizodwa nabangeneli abatshixiweyo bephelile. Izibini ezicacileyo ziqhelekile kakhulu kwiimfumba ezinzima, izithathu ezicacileyo zinqabile ngakumbi. Kufanelekile ukuzijonga zombini kuyo yonke iyunithi esenazo iiseli ezingenanto ezintlanu nangaphezulu.
spot: Khangela iiseli ezinabangeneli ababini kuphela uze ufumane enye iseli kwiyunithi enye enabo ababini abafanayo. Kwizithathu, jonga iiyunithi ezineeseli ezininzi ezinabangeneli ababini nabathathu uze ujonge ukuba ezintathu kuzo zizonke zisebenzisa amanani amathathu ahlukeneyo kuphela. Iiseli ezinabangeneli abafanayo ngqo zibonakala lula xa amanqaku ebhaliwe; iqhosha elithi Zalisa amanqaku emdlalweni likwenza oko ngokucofa kanye.

steps: {unit}: iiseli {cellA} kunye ne-{cellB} zinabangeneli ababini abafanayo ngqo, i-{d1} ne-{d2}.
Enye yazo kufuneka ibe yi-{d1} enye ibe yi-{d2}. Asazi ukuba yeyiphi, kodwa omabini amanani athathwe zezi seli zimbini.
Ngoko akukho enye iseli yale yunithi ({unit}) enokuba ne-{d1} okanye ne-{d2}. Susa {elim}.
{unit}: iiseli ezintathu zithatha bonke abangeneli bazo kumanani amathathu afanayo, {digits}: {cells}.

Amanani amathathu kufuneka azalise ezi seli zintathu ngendlela ethile. Iseli ayidingi kubonisa bonke abangeneli abathathu; okubalulekileyo kukuba akukho nanye kwezi seli zintathu enomngeneli ongaphandle kweli qela.
Susa amanani {digits} kuyo yonke enye iseli yale yunithi ({unit}): {elim}.

mistakes: Ukuthatha iiseli ezimbini ezabelana ngabangeneli ababini kodwa ezinomngeneli wesithathu. Kwisibini esicacileyo, iseli nganye kufuneka ibe nabangeneli ababini kanye kwaye kungabikho nto yimbi.
Ukususa amanani kwiiseli zesibini ngokwazo. Isibini sigcina abangeneli baso; ukususwa kusiya kwezinye iiseli zeyunithi.
Ukufuna ukuba iseli nganye yesithathu ibonise omathathu amanani. Iseli enamabini kwamathathu ilungile, ukuba nje akukho seli inomngeneli ongaphandle kweqela.
faq: Yintoni isibini esicacileyo kwi-Sudoku?
Ziiseli ezimbini kwiyunithi enye ezinabangeneli ababini abafanayo ngqo zombini. Loo manani mabini atshixiwe kwezo seli zimbini, ngoko angasuswa kwiyunithi eseleyo.
Yintoni isithathu esicacileyo?

Ziiseli ezintathu kwiyunithi enye ezinabangeneli abangamanani amathathu kuphela xa bedibene. Iseli nganye ingaba namabini okanye amathathu kuwo. Amanani amathathu azalisa iiseli ezintathu, ngoko angasuswa kwezinye iiseli zeyunithi.
Ingaba isibini esicacileyo sifaka inani?
Hayi sodwa. Sisusa abangeneli, kwaye ukususwa kudla ngokushiya eyodwa ecacileyo okanye efihlakeleyo. Icebiso kwi-Bare Sudoku libonisa eyodwa leyo kwaye libiza igama lendlela eyenze ukuba kwenzeke.
Ingaba isibini esicacileyo singaba kwibhokisi nakumgca ngaxeshanye?
Ewe. Ukuba iiseli ezimbini zabelana ngomgca nangebhokisi, isibini sisusa kuzo zombini iiyunithi. I-Bare Sudoku izisebenza iyunithi enye ngexesha.

hidden-pairs.name: Izibini nezithathu ezifihlakeleyo
hidden-pairs.title: Izibini nezithathu ezifihlakeleyo kwi-Sudoku: ukuzibona
hidden-pairs.description: Isibini esifihlakeleyo ngamanani amabini angena kuphela kwiiseli ezimbini ezifanayo zeyunithi, ngoko abanye abangeneli bazo bayasuswa. Funda ukuzifumana.
hidden-pairs.h1: Izibini nezithathu ezifihlakeleyo (hidden pairs, hidden triples)
hidden-pairs.summary: Isibini esifihlakeleyo ngamanani amabini athi, ngaphakathi komgca omnye, ikholam enye okanye ibhokisi enye, abe ngabangeneli kwiiseli ezimbini ezifanayo kwaye kungabikho ndawo yimbi. Ezo seli zimbini kufuneka zibe nala manani mabini, ngoko nawuphi na omnye umngeneli kuzo angasuswa. Isithathu esifihlakeleyo sisebenza ngendlela efanayo namanani amathathu avalelwe kwiiseli ezintathu. Emva kokususa, iiseli zibonisa isibini okanye isithathu esicacileyo. Icebiso le-Bare Sudoku liphawula ukufaka okulandelayo ngamazwi athi "Isibini okanye isithathu".
when: Xa iyunithi ineeseli ezinabangeneli abaninzi kwaye ezizodwa ziphelile. Izibini ezifihlakeleyo zizimela kwiiseli ezixakekileyo, yiyo loo nto kufanelekile ukuzikhangela kanye apho izibini ezicacileyo zingabonakaliyo. Izithathu ezifihlakeleyo zinqabile; i-Bare Sudoku iyazijonga, kodwa uninzi lweemfumba ezinzima lusonjululwa ngaphandle kwazo.
spot: Sebenza ngenani, hayi ngeseli. Kwiyunithi, phawula iiseli apho inani ngalinye elingekhoyo linokungena khona. Ukuba amanani amabini lilinye linendawo ezimbini kuphela ezinokwenzeka kwaye zezo seli zimbini zifanayo, unesibini esifihlakeleyo. Emdlalweni, cofa iqhosha lenani ukuze ukhanyise abangeneli balo; ukuba amanani amabini akhanyisa iiseli ezimbini ezifanayo zeyunithi kwaye akukho nto yimbi kuyo, yipateni leyo.

steps: {unit}: amanani {d1} ne-{d2} lilinye linendawo ezimbini kuphela ezinokwenzeka, kwaye zezimbini ezifanayo: {cells}.
Ezo seli zimbini kufuneka zibe ne-{d1} ne-{d2}, ngoko abanye abangeneli bazo abanakwenzeka.
Susa {elim}. Ngoku iiseli ezimbini zibonisa isibini esicacileyo, esinokuvula okungakumbi.

mistakes: Ukususa amanani amabini esibini kwiiseli zesibini. Ngabanye abangeneli bezo seli abasuswayo; amanani esibini ayahlala.
Ukwamkela inani elinendawo yesithathu enokwenzeka kwiyunithi. Omabini amanani kufuneka avalelwe kwezo seli zimbini kanye.
Ukukhangela kwiibhokisi kuphela. Izibini ezifihlakeleyo zivela rhoqo ngokulinganayo nakwimigca nakwiikholam.
faq: Yintoni isibini esifihlakeleyo kwi-Sudoku?
Ngamanani amabini angena kuphela kwiiseli ezimbini ezifanayo zeyunithi. Ezo seli kufuneka zithathe loo manani, ngoko abanye abangeneli bazo bayasuswa.
Isibini esifihlakeleyo sahluke njani kwisibini esicacileyo?

Isibini esicacileyo siyabonakala: iiseli ezimbini ezibonisa abangeneli ababini abafanayo kuphela. Isibini esifihlakeleyo sigqunywe ngabangeneli abongezelelweyo kwezo seli zimbini. Ukususa abo bongezelelweyo kuguqula isibini esifihlakeleyo sibe sisibini esicacileyo.
Yintoni isithathu esifihlakeleyo?

Ngamanani amathathu avalelwe kwiiseli ezintathu zeyunithi. Akuyomfuneko ukuba inani ngalinye libonakale kuzo zontathu iiseli; okubalulekileyo kukuba akukho nalinye kula manani mathathu elinomngeneli ngaphandle kwezo seli.
Ingaba icebiso liyazahlula izibini ezifihlakeleyo nezicacileyo?
Hayi. I-Bare Sudoku ifumana zombini kwaye iphawula ukufaka okulandelayo ngamazwi athi "Isibini okanye isithathu". Amaphepha apha ayazahlula kuba zifunyanwa ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.

x-wing.name: X-Wing
x-wing.title: X-Wing kwi-Sudoku: isebenza njani le ndlela
x-wing.description: X-Wing: inani elingangena kwiiseli ezimbini kanye kwimigca emibini, kwiikholam ezimbini ezifanayo, lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zezo kholam. Umzekelo wokwenyani.
x-wing.summary: I-X-Wing yipateni yenani elinye neeseli ezine ezikwiikona zoxande. Ukuba inani linomngeneli kwiiseli ezimbini kanye kumgca ngamnye kwemibini, kwaye ezo seli zikwiikholam ezimbini ezifanayo, inani kufuneka lithathe iikona ezimbini ezijongeneyo zoxande. Ngoko lingasuswa kuyo yonke enye iseli yezo kholam zimbini. Kusebenza ngendlela efanayo xa imigca neekholam zitshintshiwe. Yindlela yokuqala yeNgcali kwi-Bare Sudoku.
when: Xa ezizodwa, abangeneli abatshixiweyo nezibini nezithathu ziphelile. I-X-Wing yeyona pateni yeNgcali iqhelekileyo kwaye idla ngokuvela xa inani linabangeneli abambalwa abaseleyo, ngokuqhelekileyo xa sele kufakwe iikopi ezine ukuya kwezintandathu. Ifuna amanqaku apheleleyo enani olihlolayo.
spot: Khetha inani uze ukhangele imigca apho linomngeneli kwiiseli ezimbini kanye. Ukuba imigca emibini enjalo yabelana ngeekholam ezimbini ezifanayo, jonga ezo kholam ukuba zinabanye abangeneli belo nani: abo ngabasuswayo. Emva koko phinda usebenzisa iikholam njengesiseko. Emdlalweni, cofa iqhosha lenani: wonke umngeneli walo uyakhanyiswa, kwaye uxande lwamanqaku amane akhanyisiweyo lubonakala lula.

steps: Inani {d} linomngeneli kwiiseli ezimbini kanye kumgca {r1} nakwiiseli ezimbini kanye kumgca {r2}, kwaye zime kwiikholam ezimbini ezifanayo, {c1} ne-{c2}: {cells}.
Umgca {r1} ufaka i-{d} yawo kwikholam {c1} okanye {c2}, kwaye umgca {r2} ufaka i-{d} yawo kwenye. Nokuba kunjani, iikholam {c1} ne-{c2} nganye ifumana i-{d} kule migca mibini.
Ngoko i-{d} ayinakuvela naphi na kwiikholam {c1} ne-{c2}. Susa i-{d} kwiiseli {elim}.

mistakes: Ukusebenzisa umgca onomngeneli welo nani kwiiseli ezintathu. Umgca ngamnye wesiseko kufuneka ube nezimbini kanye, kwaye zombini zibe kwiikholam ezimbini ekwabelwana ngazo.
Ukususa inani emigceni endaweni yeekholam. Xa imigca isisiseko, ukususwa kukwiikholam, kwaye ngokuchaseneyo.
Ukulibala uhlobo olutshintshiweyo. I-X-Wing eyakhelwe kwiikholam isusa emigceni.
faq: Yintoni i-X-Wing kwi-Sudoku?

Linani elinomngeneli kwiiseli ezimbini kanye kumgca ngamnye kwemibini, kwiikholam ezimbini ezifanayo. Inani lithatha iikona ezimbini ezijongeneyo zolo xande, ngoko lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zezo kholam zimbini. Imigca neekholam zingatshintshwa.
Kutheni i-X-Wing isebenza?

Umgca ngamnye kwemibini kufuneka ufake inani kwenye yeekholam ezimbini, kwaye imigca emibini ayinakusebenzisa ikholam enye. Ngoko iikholam ezimbini nganye ifumana ikopi yayo yenani kule migca, kwaye wonke omnye umngeneli kwezo kholam akanakwenzeka.
Ingaba i-X-Wing yintlanzi?
Ewe. I-X-Wing yintlanzi yobukhulu obubini; i-Swordfish yintlanzi yobukhulu obuthathu. I-Bare Sudoku iyazifumana zombini.
Leliphi inqanaba eline-X-Wing?
Ingcali. Imfumba efuna i-X-Wing, i-Y-Wing, i-Swordfish okanye i-XYZ-Wing ibekwa kwinqanaba leNgcali.

y-wing.name: Y-Wing
y-wing.title: Y-Wing kwi-Sudoku: isebenza njani le ndlela
y-wing.description: Y-Wing (XY-Wing): iziko elinabangeneli ababini namaphiko amabini, ngalinye labelana ngomnye wabo, akhupha inani kuzo zonke iiseli ezibona omabini amaphiko.
y-wing.summary: I-Y-Wing, ekwabizwa ngokuba yi-XY-Wing, isebenzisa iiseli ezintathu ezinabangeneli ababini nganye. Iziko linabangeneli u-X no-Y. Iphiko elinye libona iziko kwaye lino-X no-Z; elinye iphiko libona iziko kwaye lino-Y no-Z. Nokuba iziko liyintoni na, elinye lamaphiko kufuneka libe ngu-Z, ngoko u-Z angasuswa kuyo yonke iseli ebona omabini amaphiko. Yindlela yeNgcali kwi-Bare Sudoku.
when: Xa imfumba ineeseli ezininzi ezinabangeneli ababini kanye kwaye akukho ntlanzi ifumanekayo. Ii-Y-Wing ziqhelekile kwiimfumba zeNgcali kwaye zifunyanwa ngokulandela iiseli ezinabangeneli ababini: nganye ingaba liziko okanye iphiko.
spot: Bhala uluhlu lweeseli ezinabangeneli ababini kanye. Nganye yazo, yithathe njengeziko elinabangeneli u-X no-Y, uze ukhangele phakathi kwabamelwane bayo iseli eno-X nelinye inani u-Z, neseli eno-Y no-Z ofanayo. Ezo zimbini ngamaphiko. Emva koko fumana iiseli ezibona omabini amaphiko kwaye zino-Z. Qaphela ukuba amaphiko akufuneki abonane.

steps: Iziko {pivot} linabangeneli i-{x} ne-{y}. Libona iseli {wingA}, ene-{x} ne-{z}, neseli {wingB}, ene-{y} ne-{z}.
Ukuba iziko {pivot} liyi-{x}, iseli {wingA} iphulukana ne-{x} ize ibe yi-{z}. Ukuba iziko {pivot} liyi-{y}, iseli {wingB} iba yi-{z}. Kuzo zonke iimeko elinye lamaphiko amabini liyi-{z}.
Iseli ebona omabini amaphiko ayinakuze ibe yi-{z}. Susa i-{z} kwiiseli {elim}.

mistakes: Ukukhetha amaphiko angaliboniyo iziko omabini. Iphiko ngalinye kufuneka labelane ngomgca, ikholam okanye ibhokisi neziko.
Ukususa u-Z kwiiseli ezibona iphiko elinye kuphela. Iseli esuswa kuyo kufuneka ibone omabini amaphiko.
Ukususa u-Z eziko. Kwi-Y-Wing iziko alinaye u-Z; ukuba linaye, ipateni yi-XYZ-Wing enemithetho eyahlukileyo.
faq: Yintoni i-Y-Wing kwi-Sudoku?

Ziiseli ezintathu ezinabangeneli ababini: iziko elino-X no-Y, iphiko elino-X no-Z elibona iziko, nephiko elino-Y no-Z elibona iziko. Elinye iphiko lihlala lingu-Z, ngoko u-Z uyasuswa kwiiseli ezibona omabini amaphiko.
Ingaba i-Y-Wing iyafana ne-XY-Wing?
Ewe. La magama mabini achaza ipateni enye. I-Bare Sudoku iyibiza ngokuba yi-Y-Wing.
Kutheni elinye iphiko kufuneka libe ngu-Z?
Ukuba iziko ngu-X, iphiko lokuqala liphulukana no-X libe ngu-Z. Ukuba iziko ngu-Y, iphiko lesibini liba ngu-Z. Iziko lingomnye kwaba babini, ngoko elinye iphiko lingu-Z.
I-Y-Wing isusa kwiiseli ezingaphi?
Ngokuqhelekileyo kwenye okanye kwezimbini: kuphela kwiiseli ezibona omabini amaphiko kwaye zisenaye u-Z. Oko kwanele ukwenza eyodwa.

swordfish.name: Swordfish
swordfish.title: Swordfish kwi-Sudoku: isebenza njani le ndlela
swordfish.description: Swordfish: inani elivalelwe kwiikholam ezintathu kwimigca emithathu lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zezo kholam. Intlanzi yobukhulu obuthathu, ichazwe ngomzekelo.
swordfish.summary: I-Swordfish yi-X-Wing enemigca emithathu neekholam ezintathu. Ukuba inani linomngeneli kwiiseli ezintathu ubuninzi kumgca ngamnye kwemithathu, kwaye zonke ezo seli ziwela kwiikholam ezintathu ezifanayo, imigca emithathu iyalisebenzisa lonke inani kwezo kholam, kwaye inani lingasuswa kuyo yonke enye iseli yezo kholam zintathu. Imigca neekholam zingatshintshwa. I-Bare Sudoku ijonga i-Swordfish emva kwe-Y-Wing, kwiimfumba zeNgcali.
when: Xa i-X-Wing ne-Y-Wing zingafumani nto. I-Swordfish inqabile ngakumbi kune-X-Wing kwaye ifuna inani elinabangeneli abasasazeke kancinci kwimigca okanye kwiikholam ezintathu. Ifuna amanqaku apheleleyo nachanekileyo aloo nani.
spot: Khetha inani uze ukhangele imigca eneeseli ezimbini okanye ezintathu ezinomngeneli walo. Ukuba imigca emithathu enjalo igubungela iikholam ezintathu kuphela zizonke, jonga ezo kholam ukuba zinabanye abangeneli belo nani. Akufuneki umgca ngamnye ube nomngeneli kwikholam nganye: i-Swordfish ingaba neeseli ezintandathu, ezisixhenxe, ezisibhozo okanye ezilithoba. Emdlalweni, khanyisa inani ngeqhosha lalo uze ukhangele imigca emithathu enabangeneli abame kwiikholam ezintathu.

steps: Inani {d} linomngeneli kwiiseli ezintathu ubuninzi kumgca ngamnye kwimigca {rows}, kwaye zonke ezo seli ziwela kwiikholam {cols}: {cells}.

Umgca ngamnye kwemithathu kufuneka ufake i-{d} yawo kwenye yeekholam ezintathu, kwaye akukho migca mibini inokusebenzisa ikholam enye. Ngoko iikholam ezintathu zifumana i-{d} yazo kule migca mithathu.
Nawuphi na omnye umngeneli we-{d} kwiikholam {cols} akanakwenzeka. Susa i-{d} kwiiseli {elim}.

mistakes: Ukufuna zonke iiseli ezilithoba. I-Swordfish enabangeneli ababini kweminye imigca isasebenza, ukuba nje imigca emithathu igubungela iikholam ezintathu kuphela.
Ukufaka umgca oneeseli ezine ezinomngeneli. Umgca ngamnye wesiseko kufuneka ube nezintathu ubuninzi, zonke ngaphakathi kweekholam ezintathu.
Ukususa kwimigca yesiseko. Xa imigca isisiseko, ukususwa kukwiikholam ezintathu, ngaphandle kwemigca yesiseko.
faq: Yintoni i-Swordfish kwi-Sudoku?
Linani elinabangeneli abakwimigca emithathu abavalelwe kwiikholam ezintathu. Imigca emithathu kufuneka ifake inani kwezo kholam zintathu, enye kwinye, ngoko inani lisuswa kwezinye iiseli zezo kholam.
I-Swordfish yahluke njani kwi-X-Wing?
Ngobukhulu kuphela: i-X-Wing isebenzisa imigca emibini neekholam ezimbini, i-Swordfish emithathu nezintathu. Ukuqiqa kuyafana.
Ingaba i-Swordfish ifuna iiseli ezilithoba kanye?
Hayi. Umgca ngamnye unokuba nabangeneli ababini okanye abathathu; ipateni ifuna kuphela ukuba imigca emithathu izonke ingasebenzisi ngaphezu kweekholam ezintathu.
Ingaba ikhona intlanzi yobukhulu obune?
Ewe, yi-Jellyfish. I-Bare Sudoku ayiyisebenzisi, kuba iimfumba zayo azize ziyidinge.

xyz-wing.name: XYZ-Wing
xyz-wing.title: XYZ-Wing kwi-Sudoku: isebenza njani le ndlela
xyz-wing.description: XYZ-Wing: iziko elinabangeneli abathathu namaphiko amabini abelana ngomnye wabo akhupha elo nani kuzo zonke iiseli ezibona zontathu. Umzekelo wokwenyani.
xyz-wing.summary: I-XYZ-Wing yi-Y-Wing eneziko elinabangeneli abathathu. Iziko lino-X, u-Y no-Z; iphiko elinye libona iziko kwaye lino-X no-Z, elinye libona iziko kwaye lino-Y no-Z. Enye yeeseli ezintathu kufuneka ibe ngu-Z, ngoko u-Z angasuswa kuyo yonke iseli ebona zontathu. Ekubeni iziko ngokwalo linokuba ngu-Z, iseli esuswa kuyo kufuneka ibone iziko kunye namaphiko omabini, nto leyo eyinciphisela kwibhokisi, kumgca okanye kwikholam ekwabelwana ngayo ziiseli. Yeyona ndlela inzima esetyenziswa yi-Bare Sudoku.
when: Kuphela xa yonke enye into isilela. Ii-XYZ-Wing zezona pateni zinqabileyo kwi-Bare Sudoku kwaye zivela kuphela kwiimfumba zeNgcali. Yikhangele xa iseli enabangeneli abathathu ihleli kwibhokisi eneseli enabangeneli ababini eyabelana ngamanani amabini ayo.
spot: Qala kwiiseli ezinabangeneli abathathu kanye; nganye iliziko elinokwenzeka. Phakathi kwabamelwane bayo, khangela iiseli ezimbini ezinabangeneli ababini nganye, bobabini bethathwe kwabathathu beziko, ezabelana ngenani elinye kanye u-Z. Emva koko khangela iiseli ezibona iziko namaphiko omabini kwaye zino-Z.
